english: Iwaki lies on the Pacific side of southern Mutsu, where valleys descend from the Abukuma highlands towards the sea. The Iwaki family held this country before the Tokugawa settlement. In 1602 Torii Tadamasa took their place and began building a new castle at Taira. A town grew around its walls, and the castle became the seat of successive lords of the Iwakitaira domain.
simp_chinese: 岩城位于陆奥南部的太平洋一侧，河谷从阿武隈高地向海延伸。德川时代以前，岩城氏统治此地。1602年鸟居忠政取代岩城氏，并开始兴建新的平城。城墙周围逐渐形成城下町，此城也成为历代磐城平藩主的居所。

english: Iwal is an Austronesian language of northeastern Papua New Guinea. Its speakers belong to the mountainous coastal region of the Huon Gulf, where steep forested country meets the sea. Neighbouring communities speak languages from different families, reflecting the diversity of this part of New Guinea.
simp_chinese: 伊瓦尔语是巴布亚新几内亚东北部的一种南岛语言。其使用者属于休恩湾沿岸多山地区，陡峭的森林地带在此与大海相接。邻近社群使用不同语系的语言，反映了新几内亚这一地区的多样性。

english:
Iwanai stood on the western coast of Ezo within an older Ainu world of coastal settlement and exchange. Japanese commercial institutions expanded there through the Matsumae trading system. In 1751 Okada Yazaemon of the Ōmi merchant house Ebisuya became contractor for the Iwanai and Furuu trading districts. The trading headquarters he established was called an unjōya, linking merchants' business with the administration of exchange.

The fisheries drew the locality into the wider commerce of the Japan Sea coast. Merchants sought northern marine products, while the Ainu encountered an increasingly unequal system of controlled trade and labour. Iwanai's eighteenth-century institutional beginnings therefore belonged to the growth of a commercial fishery on an already inhabited shore. Boats carried products to distant markets, and the trading station concentrated dealings that had formerly depended on older local relationships.
simp_chinese:
岩内位于虾夷地西岸，属于较早阿伊努沿海定居与交换的世界。日本商业机构通过松前贸易体系向这里扩展。1751年，近江商号惠美须屋的冈田弥三右卫门成为岩内、古宇两处“场所”的承包人，他设立的交易总部称为“运上屋”，把商人经营与交换管理集中到一处。

渔业使当地进入更广阔的日本海贸易。商人需要北方海产，阿伊努则面对越来越不平等的贸易与劳动控制。岩内十八世纪商业机构的建立，属于渔业经营在既有人居海岸上的发展。舟船把物产送往远方市场，交易站则将原有地方关系中的交往，纳入更集中的商业安排。

english: Iwase in southern Mutsu encompassed the country around present-day Sukagawa, where the Abukuma River and its tributaries connected settlements across the inland basin. In the medieval period its western districts belonged to the Nikaido family, while the Suda controlled the east. The Nikaido established their seat at Inamura and later ruled from Sukagawa Castle, a fortified centre with several enclosures and a surrounding castle town. Their long tenure ended in 1589, when Date Masamune captured Sukagawa. The district subsequently passed under successive rulers associated with Aizu, including the Gamo, Uesugi and Kato families. By the Edo period Sukagawa also belonged to a wider world of merchants, travellers and poetry. Matsuo Basho stayed there for eight days during his northern journey in 1689, visiting the wealthy merchant Sagara Tokyu. Local hosts arranged linked-verse gatherings and showed him nearby temples and shrines. His encounter with rice-planting songs joined the district's agricultural landscape to the literary memory of the northern road.
simp_chinese: 岩濑位于陆奥南部，包括今须贺川一带，阿武隈川及其支流连接着内陆盆地中的聚落。中世纪，郡内西部归二阶堂氏，东部由须田氏控制。二阶堂氏最初在稻村设立据点，后来以须贺川城为中心统治；城内设有多重城郭，外围形成城下聚落。1589年，伊达政宗攻陷须贺川，结束了二阶堂氏的长期统治。此后，当地先后归入蒲生、上杉和加藤等会津领主的统辖。江户时期，须贺川也参与了商旅往来和俳谐交流。1689年，松尾芭蕉北游时在此停留八日，拜访富商相乐等躬。当地人安排连句聚会，并带他游览附近寺社。田间插秧歌也给芭蕉留下深刻印象，使岩濑的农业景观进入了东北旅途的文学记忆。

english:
Iwate was a district of northern Mutsu, in the upper Kitakami country of northeastern Honshu. Its later medieval history became closely tied to the rise of the Nanbu, whose power expanded southward from Nukanobu. In 1588 Nanbu Nobunao defeated the Shiba house; in 1590 Toyotomi Hideyoshi confirmed his possession of seven northern districts. The following year Nobunao decided to move his principal seat from Sannohe to Kozukata.

The new castle occupied a hill where the old Kitakami and Nakatsu rivers met, on the site of an earlier stronghold held by the Fukushi. Construction traditionally began in 1597 and proceeded fully after formal permission in 1598. Stone walls enclosed the main and outer compounds, while moats extended into the developing settlement. Bridges built across the Nakatsu between 1609 and 1612 helped join its quarters. Morioka emerged as the domain centre through the Edo period. Within the wider Iwate district, the castle and its town gave Nanbu authority a durable administrative focus, tying river crossings and settlement growth to the consolidation of warrior government.
simp_chinese:
岩手是陆奥北部、北上川上游地区的一郡，中世纪晚期历史同南部氏从糠部向南扩张的过程密切相连。1588年，南部信直击败斯波氏；1590年，丰臣秀吉确认其拥有北方七郡。翌年，信直决定将主要居城从三户迁至不来方。

新城选在旧北上川与中津川汇合处的丘陵，原为福士氏据点。传统记载称1597年举行开工仪式，1598年正式获准后全面营建。石垣围成主要曲轮，护城河也延伸至逐渐形成的城下聚落。1609至1612年间，中津川上修建桥梁，进一步连接两岸街区。此后整个江户时代，盛冈成为藩政中心。对较广阔的岩手郡而言，城堡与城下町使南部氏权力获得持久的行政支点，将河流渡越、街区发展与武士政权的整合联系起来，也改变了此前多个地方据点并存的政治格局。

english: Iwo is a Yoruba kingdom whose ruler bears the title Oluwo. Local traditions connect its people with Ile-Ife, the sacred city from which many Yoruba ruling houses trace their origins. The town grew in the wooded country west of Ife, within a landscape of neighbouring kingdoms, farms and markets.
simp_chinese: 伊沃是一个约鲁巴王国，其统治者称为奥卢沃。当地传统将居民的起源与圣城伊莱伊费相联系，许多约鲁巴王室也从那里追溯自己的来源。城镇在伊费以西的林地中发展，周围分布着邻近王国、农田和市场。

english: Iwo Jima is a volcanic island in the Pacific south of Japan, between Kita Iwo Jima and Minami Iwo Jima. In 1779 the Resolution and Discovery passed the Volcano Islands on the return of Cook’s third voyage. The crews saw volcanic activity and smelled sulphur near Iwo Jima, which they called Sulphur Island.
simp_chinese: 硫磺岛是日本以南太平洋上的火山岛，位于北硫磺岛与南硫磺岛之间。1779年，决心号与发现号在库克第三次航行返程途中经过火山列岛。船员望见火山活动，闻到硫磺岛附近的硫磺气味，并将它称为硫磺岛。

english: The coast of Iwo Jima faces waters crossed by navigators seeking routes between the Philippines and New Spain. Bernardo de la Torre almost certainly saw the Volcano Islands in 1543 while commanding San Juan de Letrán on an unsuccessful eastward passage. His group name Balcones appears instead to have referred to an eruption in the islands, probably on South Iwo Jima. Spanish sailors subsequently passed the area without establishing settlement or a formal claim, although the islands fell within Spain's notional eastern sphere after the treaties dividing Spanish and Portuguese ambitions. Japanese knowledge also reached the island in the late sixteenth century. In 1779 John Gore visited with awareness of earlier Spanish accounts and recorded the English name Sulphur Island. The volcanic shore remained relatively neglected by the principal maritime powers for a long period, illustrating how an island could appear in accounts and imperial geographical assumptions without immediately becoming an occupied possession. Its surrounding sea preserves that earlier history of difficult trans-Pacific routes.
simp_chinese: 硫黄岛这段海岸面向航海者寻找菲律宾至新西班牙通路的水域。贝尔纳多·德拉托雷1543年率“圣胡安德莱特兰”号尝试东行失败时，几乎可以确定看见火山列岛。其群岛名Balcones似乎来自当时火山喷发，可能实际在南硫黄岛。西班牙水手随后经过，却未建立定居或正式主权，列岛仍因西葡划分势力的条约而被视为西班牙东方范围的一部分。日本人在十六世纪末也认识该岛。1779年约翰·戈尔来访时已知早期西班牙记述，并记录英语“硫黄岛”名称。火山海岸长期较少受到主要海权关注，说明岛屿可以进入记录及帝国地理设想中，而未立即成为实际占领地；周边海面保存的早期故事主要是跨太平洋艰难航路与断续经过。

english: Iwol is a Bedik village high in the hills of southeastern Senegal, regarded as the founding village of the Biwol. A great baobab known in Bedik as amack stands at its entrance; offerings and sacrifices made there honour the ancestors. Baobabs and other trees shade the village's communal work and dances. At Bedik celebrations, beer made from local cereals is shared with inhabitants and guests from neighbouring villages.
simp_chinese: 伊沃尔是塞内加尔东南部山上的贝迪克人村庄，被视为比沃尔人的创始村落。村口有一株巨大的猴面包树，贝迪克语称其为阿马克；人们在树下献祭，纪念祖先。猴面包树和其他树木为村民集体劳作、跳舞提供荫凉。在贝迪克人的庆典上，以当地谷物酿制的啤酒由居民和邻村来客共享。

english: Iwur is an Ok language of western New Guinea, also known as Murop. Its speakers belong to the island's mountainous interior, where forested ridges and river valleys form the landscape. Iwur is one of several neighbouring Papuan languages associated with communities on both sides of the highlands.
simp_chinese: 伊乌尔语是新几内亚西部的一种奥克语，也称穆罗普语。其使用者属于岛屿多山的内陆地区，森林山脊和河谷构成当地景观。伊乌尔语是与高地两侧社群有关的多种相邻巴布亚语言之一。

english: Ixcatlan was a town in the Ixcatec country of Oaxaca, with the dependent settlement of Axamulco under its authority. A map made in the sixteenth century shows its churches, place-name signs and seated ruling couples, along with boundaries toward Coixtlahuaca and Huautla and a branching river. The map's reverse is dated 14 November 1580 and names the corregidor Gonzalo Velásquez de Lara. Its Indigenous pictorial signs and Spanish or Nahuatl glosses show local territorial claims put into colonial legal procedure, and it is linked to a dispute over Axamulco in 1580.
simp_chinese: 伊斯卡特兰是瓦哈卡伊斯卡特克地区的一个城镇，其属地阿舒穆尔科也归它管辖。十六世纪绘制的一幅地图标示出教堂、地名符号和席地而坐的统治者夫妇，并画出通往科伊斯特拉瓦卡、瓦乌特拉的边界以及一条分流河道。图的背面标注日期为1580年11月14日，并列出地方行政官贡萨洛·贝拉斯克斯·德·拉腊。图中原住民图画符号与西班牙语、纳瓦特尔语注记并用，显示地方领地诉求被纳入殖民法律程序，此图与1580年阿舒穆尔科的争地事件相联系。

english: iXesi is the Xhosa name associated with the Keiskamma River in the eastern Cape. Flowing through hills towards the Indian Ocean, the river runs through country long inhabited by Xhosa communities. In the late eighteenth and early nineteenth centuries, colonial expansion brought conflict over land and cattle to the neighbouring frontier.
simp_chinese: 伊克塞西是东开普凯斯卡马河的科萨语名称。这条河穿过丘陵流向印度洋，流域长期有科萨社群居住。十八世纪末至十九世纪初，殖民扩张使邻近边疆地区爆发土地与牲畜争夺。

english:
Ixmiquilpan lies in the Mezquital Valley, an Otomí region north of the Basin of Mexico. The Tula River runs through the town, which stands on a route toward the drier northern country. Its Augustinian church of San Miguel is especially remarkable for murals that combine European ornament with images of Indigenous warriors and fantastic beings.

Construction of the church and convent began in 1550. In the later sixteenth century Indigenous painters filled the nave with scenes of combat: figures dressed as jaguar and coyote warriors carry pre-Hispanic weapons among creatures derived from several artistic traditions. The murals have been read in connection with the frontier wars of New Spain and the participation of Otomí communities. In 1655 a bridge over the Tula River joined the town to the settlement on the opposite bank.
simp_chinese:
伊斯米基尔潘位于墨西哥盆地以北的梅斯基塔尔谷地，是奥托米人的地区。图拉河流经镇中，这里也是通往北方干旱地带的道路上的一站。奥古斯丁会圣米格尔教堂尤以壁画著称，画面将欧洲装饰与原住民武士和奇异生灵相结合。

教堂与修道院于1550年开始兴建。十六世纪后期，原住民画家在中殿绘满战斗场景：身着美洲豹和郊狼装束的武士手持前西班牙时代武器，与源自多种艺术传统的生灵同处一幅画面。人们将这些壁画与新西班牙的边疆战争及奥托米社群的参与联系起来。1655年，一座跨越图拉河的桥梁将城镇与对岸聚落连接起来。

english:
Ixtacamaxtitlán was an Indigenous lordship in the highlands of present-day Puebla, close to Tlaxcala. In 1519 its ruler, Temamascuicuil, occupied a seat on the mountain called Acolhua. When Hernán Cortés arrived from Cempoala on his way toward Tlaxcala, the ruler received him and his men for three days, providing lodging and gifts. The encounter placed this highland polity directly on the expedition's inland route.

Christian institutions followed the conquest. The Franciscans undertook evangelization in this part of the mountains after 1521, and San Francisco de Asís became the central religious complex of the town. Its buildings preserve a long sequence of construction: the national monuments catalogue assigns the complex a sixteenth-century origin with interventions in the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries. The town's history therefore includes both the lordship encountered by the expedition and the gradual creation of a Franciscan religious centre.
simp_chinese:
伊斯塔卡马什蒂特兰是今普埃布拉州高地、邻近特拉斯卡拉的原住民领地。1519年，统治者特马马斯奎奎尔以阿科尔瓦山上的聚落为驻地。埃尔南·科尔特斯从森波阿拉前往特拉斯卡拉途中抵达这里，得到领主接待，与部下停留三天，获供住宿和礼物。这场会面使高地领地直接进入远征队向内陆推进的行程。

征服之后，基督教机构逐渐建立。1521年以后，方济各会士在这一带山区传教，阿西西的圣方济各建筑群成为镇内的重要宗教中心。建筑记录保留了长期营建的层次：国家历史建筑名录将其起源列入十六世纪，并记载十七、十八世纪的改建。当地历史因此既包括远征队所遇的原住民领地，也包括方济各会宗教中心逐渐成形的过程。

english:
Ixtachichimecapan was the Otomi settlement associated with the river valley later called San Juan del Río in Querétaro. Its inhabitants gathered around Techimacit hill, now the Barrio de la Cruz, where agriculture and houses occupied the river hollow. Local historical tradition remembers a chief called Mexici, subsequently baptised Juan. The older settlement gave the colonial town a foundation of people, cultivated land and recognised local leadership.

San Juan del Río traditionally dates its establishment as an Indigenous town to 24 June 1531. Together with Querétaro it became a frontier centre during Spanish expansion toward the Chichimeca country, and later an intermediate point between Mexico City and the mining districts of Zacatecas and San Luis Potosí. It belonged to the alcaldía mayor of Querétaro. Indigenous government continued through a governor, alcaldes, constables, crop officials and a scribe, alongside royal jurisdiction. By 1693 the church and convent of Santo Domingo had been completed beside the main road. The town's history thus combined Otomi institutions with the traffic, missions and administration of the colonial interior.
simp_chinese:
伊斯塔奇奇梅卡潘是克雷塔罗境内、后来称作圣胡安德尔里奥的河谷中的奥托米聚落。居民聚居于特奇米西特山周围，即后来的十字架街区，在河道形成的谷地中建屋耕作。地方历史传统记有首领梅西西，受洗后名为胡安。早期聚落为殖民城镇留下人口、耕地和既有地方领导关系。

圣胡安德尔里奥传统建镇日为1531年6月24日，最初为原住民城镇。它同克雷塔罗一起，在西班牙向奇奇梅克地区扩张时成为边疆中心，后来又成为墨西哥城与萨卡特卡斯、圣路易斯波托西矿区之间的中途节点，隶属克雷塔罗大行政区。原住民政务仍由本族长官、地方执政官、治安人员、农田官与书记等办理，同时接受王室管辖。至1693年，主要道路旁的圣多明各教堂和修道院已经建成。奥托米制度由此同殖民内陆的交通、传教及行政机构持续交织。

english: In the hot Balsas basin near Ixtapan lies Zirándaro, a riverside settlement once subject to the lordship of Michoacán. A sixteenth-century account describes its broad valley, plum trees and a river rich in fish and caimans. The first Spanish expedition arrived from Pátzcuaro in 1524, when the local lord was called Zemboruta.
simp_chinese: 伊斯塔潘附近的炎热巴尔萨斯河流域，有一座河畔聚落锡兰达罗，曾受米却肯领主统辖。16世纪的记载描述了当地宽阔的河谷、李树，以及盛产鱼类和凯门鳄的河流。1524年，首批西班牙远征者从帕茨夸罗抵达此地，当时当地领主名叫森博鲁塔。

english:
Ixtlahuaca lay in the Mazahua highlands northwest of Toluca, on routes leading from central Mexico toward Michoacan. Its older Mazahua settlement was known as J'apui and was associated with the lordship of Jocotitlan. During the later fifteenth century, Mexica campaigns subjected the wider Mazahua country to tribute. Spanish conquest brought another change of rulers in 1521.

Hernan Cortes assigned Ixtlahuaca in encomienda to Juan de la Torre, whose tenure lasted until 1535. It became a colonial administrative centre for a broad district including Jiquipilco, Jocotitlan, Atlacomulco and Temascalcingo. The Spanish parish settlement developed west of the older J'apui, shortening the road, and received recognition as a pueblo under Viceroy Luis de Velasco in 1552. Houses gathered around the parish site as church and government institutions reshaped the local centre. The road continued to carry travellers toward western Mexico. A further institutional change came on 16 July 1820, when Ixtlahuaca installed its first constitutional ayuntamiento under the restored Cadiz constitutional system, before Mexican independence.
simp_chinese:
伊斯特拉瓦卡位于托卢卡西北的马萨瓦高地，处在墨西哥中部通往米却肯的道路上。较早的马萨瓦聚落称J'apui，与霍科蒂特兰领地有关。十五世纪后期，墨西加军事扩张使更广大的马萨瓦地区承担贡赋，1521年的西班牙征服又带来统治者更替。

埃尔南·科尔特斯将伊斯特拉瓦卡授予胡安·德·拉托雷作为监护征赋区，其任期持续至1535年。这里随后成为辖区广大的殖民行政中心，所属地区包括希基皮尔科、霍科蒂特兰、阿特拉科穆尔科及特马斯卡尔辛戈。西班牙堂区聚落建在旧J'apui以西，以缩短道路，1552年在总督路易斯·德·贝拉斯科任内获授村镇地位。房屋围绕堂区发展，教会与政府机构共同重塑地方中心，通向墨西哥西部的道路持续载运旅人。1820年7月16日，伊斯特拉瓦卡依据恢复实施的加的斯宪制，建立首届宪政市议会；这是墨西哥独立前又一次制度变化。

english: Ixtlahuacan lies in the uplands north of Guadalajara, in a region inhabited by Tecuexe communities before the Spanish conquest. Nuño de Guzmán reached the district in 1530. Nearby Tlacotán became an early site of Guadalajara in the 1530s, and Ixtlahuacan was included in its encomienda. The fortunes of the indigenous town were thus tied to an early colonial settlement that was itself later moved to the Atemajac valley.
simp_chinese: 伊斯特拉瓦坎位于瓜达拉哈拉以北的高地，西班牙征服前，特奎克塞人居住于此。努尼奥·德·古斯曼于 1530 年抵达该地区。附近的特拉科坦在十六世纪三十年代成为瓜达拉哈拉的早期所在地，伊斯特拉瓦坎被纳入该地的监护征赋区。这座原住民城镇的命运因而与后来迁至阿特马哈克谷地的早期殖民聚落相连。

english: Ixtlán stands in a high valley of the northern Oaxacan mountains, in a region long inhabited by Zapotec communities. Before the Spanish conquest it was an independent Zapotec polity; the mountain Zapotecs were subdued around 1523–24. In the seventeenth century Santo Tomás Ixtlán was separated from the jurisdiction of Chicomesúchil, marking another change in the organisation of the mountain settlements.
simp_chinese: 伊斯特兰坐落在瓦哈卡北部山地的一处高谷，周围长期分布着萨波特克人聚落。西班牙人征服之前，这里是一个独立的萨波特克政体；山地萨波特克人约于1523至1524年被征服。17世纪，圣托马斯伊斯特兰从奇科梅苏奇尔辖区分离出来，山地聚落的管辖关系又发生了一次变化。

english: Ixtutz was a Maya centre in the forested lowlands of southeastern Petén. Its principal plaza is enclosed by the site's largest buildings, and its carved stelae and hieroglyphic panels preserve the names and ceremonies of its rulers. In 780, a monument records a ceremony by the king Aj Yaxjal B'aak attended by an overlord and other lords. The gathering reveals the political ties that joined Ixtutz to other centres of the Maya lowlands during the Late Classic period.
simp_chinese: 伊斯图茨是佩滕东南部森林低地的一座玛雅中心。主广场由遗址最大的建筑围绕，雕刻石碑和象形文字石板保存了统治者的名字与仪式。780 年，一座纪念碑记载国王阿赫·亚什哈尔·巴克举行的仪式，其宗主和其他领主也出席了活动。这场聚会显示出古典晚期伊斯图茨与玛雅低地其他中心之间的政治联系。

english: The Cannonball River rises in the badlands of western North Dakota and flows east toward the Missouri. Its Lakota name, Íŋyaŋwakağapi Wakpá, refers to the remarkable round stones found in the region. These sandstone concretions formed when minerals cemented grains together within softer sediments; erosion subsequently exposed them. The river's upper basin is a country of dissected plateaus and isolated buttes.
simp_chinese: 坎农鲍尔河发源于北达科他西部恶地，向东流向密苏里河。它的拉科塔语名字为伊尼扬瓦卡加皮瓦克帕，与这一带奇特的圆形石头有关。这些砂岩结核形成于较软的沉积物中，矿物将砂粒胶结在一起，后来侵蚀又使它们露出地表。河流上游是一片被流水切割的高原和孤立山丘。

english:
Iyeesnime is the Nimiipuu place-name recorded for Slate Creek in present-day Idaho. A Nez Perce language-program list preserves the name alongside other named streams, villages and mountain places. It belongs to a country understood through particular waterways and communities, rather than an undifferentiated inland wilderness.

The wider Nimiipuu economy provides the historical context for the centuries before intensive outside settlement. Rivers supplied salmon and linked villages to exchange networks extending towards both the Plains and the Pacific. The arrival of horses in the early eighteenth century increased the reach of hunting parties, including journeys after bison. Root gathering remained essential alongside fishing and hunting. When Lewis and Clark entered Nimiipuu country in 1805, local people supplied foods including salmon, berries and camas bread. That encounter illustrates an established regional food system on which newcomers depended. These developments describe the surrounding Nimiipuu world; they do not establish that the expedition visited Slate Creek or that every neighbouring community followed an identical seasonal round.
simp_chinese:
伊耶斯尼梅是尼米普语中对应今天爱达荷州 Slate Creek 的地名。内兹珀斯部族语言项目的名录，将它同其他溪流、村落和山地名称一起保存。当地居民通过具体水道与社群认识这片国土，并非将其视为没有区分的内陆荒野。

更广的尼米普经济，为外来者密集定居以前的历史提供背景。河流供应鲑鱼，并将村落接入延伸至平原与太平洋的交换网络。十八世纪初马匹传入后，狩猎队活动范围扩大，包括追猎野牛的行程。采集根茎仍同渔猎一样重要。1805年刘易斯和克拉克进入尼米普地区时，当地人提供了鲑鱼、浆果与卡马斯根饼等食物，显示外来者依赖既有的区域食物体系。这些发展属于周围尼米普世界的背景，不能据此断定探险队曾到访 Slate Creek，或各邻近社群都遵循完全相同的季节活动安排。

english:
Ienne belongs to the Aldan and eastern Stanovoi country of Siberia, where forests, mountains and long winters shaped the lives of mobile communities. Hunting, fishing and the keeping of transport animals in suitable districts supported seasonal journeys between camps. Rivers offered routes, but moving through watersheds also required trails over land and knowledge of places where supplies could be found.

During the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries, Russian expansion reached the wider eastern Siberian interior through forts, tribute collection and trade. Indigenous communities faced demands for furs, while metal tools and other imported goods entered local exchange. Travellers relied on guides and intermediaries familiar with routes and sources of food. The southern mountain country lay near paths connecting the Lena basin with lands toward the Pacific, allowing camps and small settlements to participate in wider networks.
simp_chinese:
伊延格拉位于西伯利亚阿尔丹与东斯塔诺夫山区，森林、山地和漫长冬季影响着流动社群的生活。狩猎、捕鱼以及在适宜地区饲养驮畜，为营地间的季节性旅行提供支持。河流是重要路线，跨越不同水系则需要陆上小径，以及寻找给养的经验。

十七、十八世纪，俄国通过堡垒、征贡和贸易逐渐进入东西伯利亚内陆。原住民面对毛皮贡赋的要求，金属工具等外来物品也进入地方交换。旅行者需要当地向导和中介，他们熟悉道路与获取食物的地点。南部山区靠近连接勒拿河流域与太平洋方向的路线，营地和小型聚落因而也能参与广阔的往来网络。

english: Iyesyak lies in the Vilyuy country of western Yakutia, amid forest and rivers feeding the Lena system. The Vilyuy rises on the Central Siberian Plateau and flows east before joining the Lena, draining a vast region of taiga and permafrost.
simp_chinese: 伊耶夏克位于雅库特西部的维柳伊河地区，周围森林和河流属于勒拿河水系。维柳伊河发源于中西伯利亚高原，向东流后汇入勒拿河，流域内有大片泰加林和多年冻土。

english:
Iyo occupied western Shikoku, facing the Inland Sea. One of its medieval centres was Yuzuki Castle at Dogo, built by Kono Michimori during the Kenmu era of 1334–1338. The castle had inner and outer moats, hilltop enclosures and quarters for retainers. The Kono family continued to face warfare and internal disputes until 1585, when it surrendered to Kobayakawa Takakage during Toyotomi Hideyoshi’s conquest of Shikoku. Yuzuki was subsequently abandoned.

A new political centre arose on the Matsuyama Plain. Kato Yoshiaki began building Matsuyama Castle on Katsuyama in 1602 after his holdings were enlarged following Sekigahara. Construction continued for about a quarter-century and passed to another lord when Kato was transferred to Aizu in 1627. Matsudaira Sadayuki arrived from Kuwana in 1635 with a domain assessed at 150,000 koku.
simp_chinese:
伊予位于四国西部，面向濑户内海。中世纪的重要中心之一是道后的汤筑城，河野通盛于建武年间（1334—1338年）筑城。城内设有内外两道护城河、山顶曲轮及家臣居住区。河野氏此后不断面对战争与内讧，直到1585年丰臣秀吉征服四国时向小早川隆景降服，汤筑城随后废弃。

松山平原上继而兴起新的政治中心。关原之战后，加藤嘉明的领地扩大，1602年开始在胜山修筑松山城。工程持续约四分之一世纪；1627年加藤氏转封会津时，筑城工作交由继任领主继续。1635年，松平定行由桑名转入，领有按十五万石评估的松山藩。

english:
Lake Izabal, known in colonial accounts as the Golfo Dulce, formed part of the water route between Guatemala's interior and the Caribbean. The Río Dulce carried traffic from the lake toward the sea, while the Polochic connected its western side with the Verapaz country. Warehouses on this route held goods moving through a corridor that combined lake navigation, river travel and inland transport.

The same access exposed the warehouses and settlements to seaborne raiders. Spanish authorities developed fortifications at the lake's outlet during the seventeenth century; the stronghold became known as San Felipe de Lara. Repeated attacks in the later seventeenth century struck both the defences and the commercial installations. Raids in the 1680s extended into the Polochic route, showing that danger reached beyond the coastal entrance. Fortification remained an official concern in the eighteenth century. Engineer Luis Díez Navarro inspected the area in 1743, and Matías de Gálvez reinforced its defences in 1779. The lake consequently occupied a guarded passage between inland production and Caribbean shipping.
simp_chinese:
伊萨瓦尔湖在殖民时期又称甜水湾，是危地马拉内陆通向加勒比海的水路环节。杜尔塞河将湖泊连接海岸，西侧波洛奇克河则通向韦拉帕斯地区。沿线仓库储放转运货物，湖上航行、河道运输与内陆道路在此衔接。

这条通道也使仓库和居民点遭到海上袭击者威胁。十七世纪，西班牙当局在湖泊出口发展防御设施，堡垒后来称圣费利佩德拉拉。十七世纪后期，多次袭击破坏堡垒与贸易设施；1680年代的劫掠还深入波洛奇克河沿线，危险越过了近海入口。十八世纪，筑防仍是官府事务。工程师路易斯·迭斯·纳瓦罗于1743年视察此区，马蒂亚斯·德加尔韦斯又于1779年加强防御。湖泊因此成为内陆物产与加勒比航运之间一条受到守卫的通道。

english: Cape Izasa projects into the Sea of Japan on the coast of Tajima. The rugged shoreline around Amarube is cut into cliffs and small inlets, with fishing settlements tucked between mountain slopes and the sea. The cape marks one of the headlands along the coast between the bays of Tajima and Tango. Its rocky profile provides a landmark for vessels following the shore through these waters.
simp_chinese: 伊座岬从但马海岸伸入日本海。余部周围的崎岖海岸有悬崖和小海湾，渔村坐落在山坡与大海之间。此岬是但马与丹后海湾之间众多岬角之一，突出的岩石轮廓为沿岸经过这片水域的船只提供地标。

english: Izberdey takes its name from the Izberdeyka River, which flows into the Matyra in the country west of Tambov. The river gave its name to more than one village, including Bolshoy and Maly Izberdey. Bolshoy Izberdey had grown into a substantial settlement by 1719. Earlier, the Matyra outpost founded in 1644 had formed part of the Tambov frontier line, built to guard the region against raids from the steppe.
simp_chinese: 伊兹别尔杰伊得名于坦波夫以西的伊兹别尔杰伊卡河，该河流入马特拉河。河流为多处村庄命名，包括大伊兹别尔杰伊和小伊兹别尔杰伊。到1719年，大伊兹别尔杰伊已发展为较大聚落。更早时，1644年建立的马特拉哨堡属于坦波夫边防线的一部分，用以防备来自草原的袭击。

english: Izboishchi stands on the Kobozha River, in the wooded country between Novgorod and the lands of Belozero. Its inhabitants appear in a fifteenth-century birch-bark letter found at Novgorod: peasants of Izboishchi addressed a petition to a man named Ondreyan Mikhailovich. The historian Valentin Yanin associated that letter with the churchyard on the Kobozha, linking this small settlement to the written records of medieval Novgorod.
simp_chinese: 伊兹博伊希坐落在科博扎河畔，位于诺夫哥罗德与别洛奥泽罗之间的林地。当地居民出现在诺夫哥罗德出土的一封十五世纪桦树皮书信中：伊兹博伊希的农民向一位名叫翁德列扬·米哈伊洛维奇的人递交请求。历史学家瓦连京·亚宁将这封信与科博扎河畔的教区聚落联系起来，使这处小村与中世纪诺夫哥罗德的文字记录相连。

english:
Izborsk guarded the western approaches to Pskov from its heights above the lake country. A fortified settlement existed here by the early medieval period, and the town became a key stronghold on the frontier of the Novgorod lands. It was taken and retaken during wars with the Livonian knights in the thirteenth century. In 1330 Sheloga, a Pskov #italic posadnik#!, and the people of Pskov and Izborsk built a new stone fortress on Zheravya Hill, digging ditches below its walls.

Izborsk belonged to Pskov when that republic separated from Novgorod in 1348. The fortress withstood repeated sieges, but in 1569 a small Lithuanian force gained entry by deception and briefly took it. Ivan IV recovered the stronghold, yet the affair provoked executions and deepened his suspicions of treason in the northwestern towns. Lithuanian troops captured Izborsk again during the siege of Pskov in 1581; the truce of Yam-Zapolsky returned it to Russia the following year. After the Great Northern War moved the frontier westward, Izborsk's ancient walls no longer guarded the edge of the state.
simp_chinese:
伊兹博尔斯克坐落在湖区上方的高地，守卫通往普斯科夫的西部道路。中世纪早期这里已有设防聚落，城镇后来成为诺夫哥罗德土地边疆的重要据点。十三世纪，它在与利沃尼亚骑士的战争中数度易手。1330年，普斯科夫市长谢洛加与普斯科夫、伊兹博尔斯克居民在热拉维亚山上修建新石堡，并在墙下挖掘壕沟。

1348年普斯科夫共和国脱离诺夫哥罗德时，伊兹博尔斯克属于普斯科夫。堡垒抵御了多次围攻，但1569年一支小型立陶宛部队以欺骗手段进入，短暂占领此地。伊凡四世重新夺回据点，这一事件却引发处决，并加深了他对西北部城镇叛变的疑虑。1581年围攻普斯科夫期间，立陶宛军队再次占领伊兹博尔斯克；次年的亚姆-扎波利耶停战协定使其重归俄罗斯。大北方战争后，边界向西推移，伊兹博尔斯克的古墙不再守卫国家边缘。

english: Izdeshkovo lay among the villages and landed estates of the Vyazma district in the Smolensk country. The village first appears in a land survey of 1776–79, when several proprietors shared it. By 1799 it had thirteen households and 126 inhabitants. Nearby settlements included Morozovo and Bliznetsy, whose lands had belonged to the Yakushkin estate in the late sixteenth century. The old village stood west of a later settlement on the Dyma River.
simp_chinese: 伊兹杰什科沃位于斯摩棱斯克地区的维亚济马县，处在村庄与地主庄园之间。1776至1779年的土地调查首次记载此村，当时由多位业主共有。1799年村中有13户、126名居民。附近的莫罗佐沃与布利兹涅齐等聚落，其土地十六世纪末属于雅库什金庄园。旧村位于后来迪马河畔新聚落的西侧。

english:
Izeh occupies a small valley in the Zagros east of the Karun River. In medieval accounts it appears as Mal-i Amir or Malamir, a seat of the Hazaraspid atabegs of Greater Luristan. Their dynasty governed the mountain country until 1424. Its rulers improved caravan movement by cutting a paved road through the Zagros, remembered as the Atabeg's Road or King's Road. The town consequently stood within a mountain principality whose routes connected the interior with Khuzestan.

Shah Rukh's destruction of the atabeg dynasty changed the valley's fortunes. Malamir was gradually deserted, and the fortress of Mongasht fell into ruin. Under the Safavids, the plain became part of the territory of the Bakhtiari confederacy. A few permanent settlements remained, while migratory pastoralism came to dominate the region's social life. The early modern landscape was therefore shaped by a substantial break in urban occupation. The valley retained its place among the Zagros routes, but the medieval seat of rulers gave way to a country of pastoral movement and scattered settlement.
simp_chinese:
伊泽位于卡伦河以东的扎格罗斯山间小谷地。中世纪文献称之为马勒阿米尔或马拉米尔，是大卢里斯坦哈扎拉斯皮德阿塔贝格王朝的统治中心。该王朝延续至1424年，统治者曾在山中开凿铺砌商路，后称阿塔贝格路或王道。城镇由此置身于连接伊朗内陆和胡齐斯坦的山地交通网络。

沙哈鲁消灭阿塔贝格王朝后，谷地命运改变。马拉米尔逐渐荒废，蒙加什特堡垒也沦为废墟。萨法维时期，平原纳入巴赫蒂亚里部落联盟地域，仅存少数固定居民点，季节迁徙的畜牧生活成为当地社会的主要形态。近代早期的景观因此经历明显的城市生活中断；谷地仍处在扎格罗斯交通线上，原先的王朝驻地则逐渐成为牧民往来、聚落零散的山间地域。

english:
Izhevsk grew beside the Izh River around an ironworks founded in 1760. The land had earlier belonged to the Kazan Khanate; after its conquest, Ivan IV granted lands by the Izh and Karlutka to the Tatar noble Bagish Yaushev. Count Pyotr Shuvalov later obtained permission to build ironworks in the Kama region. Serfs from nearby villages and craftsmen from his other plants began a dam on the Izh, and the first iron was produced in 1763. That year the works passed to the Crown for the Shuvalov family's debts.

Harsh labor conditions helped fuel support for Yemelyan Pugachev's uprising. Rebel detachments entered the settlement in January 1774 and destroyed parts of the works; Pugachev himself returned in June, and some workers joined his army. The plant was restored by the end of 1775. Its iron had already been supplied for building works in Moscow and Saint Petersburg, and the factory settlement continued to develop as a center of metalworking.
simp_chinese:
伊热夫斯克围绕1760年建于伊日河畔的炼铁厂发展起来。这片土地曾属于喀山汗国；征服汗国后，伊凡四世将伊日河和卡尔卢特卡河附近的土地赐给鞑靼贵族巴吉什·尧舍夫。后来彼得·舒瓦洛夫伯爵获准在卡马河地区建造铁厂。附近村庄的农奴和他其他工厂的工匠开始在伊日河筑坝，1763年产出第一批铁；同年，工厂因舒瓦洛夫家族的债务归入国家。

艰苦的劳动条件促使部分工人支持叶梅利扬·普加乔夫的起义。1774年1月，起义部队进入聚落，毁坏了部分工厂；6月普加乔夫本人再次抵达，一些工人加入其军队。工厂在1775年末恢复生产。伊热夫斯克的铁此前已供应莫斯科和圣彼得堡的建筑工程，厂区聚落继续发展为金属加工中心。

english:
Izhma grew from a settlement founded in the later sixteenth century on a tributary of the Pechora. Komi newcomers, Russian neighbours and Nenets contributed to the formation of the Izvatas, the Izhma Komi. By 1646 the village contained sixty-five peasant households. Hunting and fishing initially supported its economy alongside livestock and cultivation.

Reindeer husbandry, learned from Nenets neighbours, became the leading occupation by the middle of the eighteenth century. Settlement also spread along the river: Sizyabsk, Gam, Lasta, Mokhcha and Moshyuga were founded between 1745 and 1763. Herds and new villages widened the community's connections beyond its original centre. In 1820 the peasant Prokopiy Anufriev financed Izhma's first parish school. The village thus combined a developing pastoral economy with permanent households and institutions, rather than relying entirely on the seasonal movements of the herds.
simp_chinese:
伊日马由十六世纪后期建立的聚落发展而来，位于伯朝拉河的一条支流上。科米移民、俄罗斯邻人及涅涅茨人共同参与了伊日马科米人、亦称 Izvatas 的形成。到1646年，村中已有六十五个农户。早期经济以狩猎、捕鱼为主，也兼营畜牧和耕作。

从涅涅茨邻人处学来的驯鹿饲养，到十八世纪中叶成为主要产业。聚落也沿河扩展：西佳布斯克、加姆、拉斯塔、莫赫恰与莫休加等村在1745至1763年间相继建立。鹿群与新村拓宽了社群在原有中心以外的联系。1820年，农民普罗科皮·阿努弗里耶夫出资开办伊日马第一所教区学校。村落因此将发展的牧业与常住家庭、公共机构结合起来，其生活并不完全随鹿群季节移动。

english:
Iziaslav, historically Zaslav, stands on the Horyn in eastern Volhynia. It grew from two neighbouring towns, Old Zaslav, recorded in 1386, and New Zaslav, founded in the sixteenth century. Castles, churches and noble residences marked its place among the estates of the great princely families.

The Ostrogski princes held Zaslav from the fourteenth century; a branch of the family took the name Zasławski from the town. In 1673 it passed to the Sanguszko family. After the partitions of Poland the town became part of the Russian Empire and served briefly as the centre of a vicegerency before becoming a district town in Volhynia in the late eighteenth century. Its old fortifications and churches recall the authority and patronage of its successive owners.
simp_chinese:
伊贾斯拉夫历史上称为扎斯拉夫，坐落在沃里尼亚东部的霍伦河畔。它由两座相邻城镇发展而来：旧扎斯拉夫见于1386年的记载，新扎斯拉夫则创建于十六世纪。城堡、教堂和贵族府邸体现了它在显赫公爵家族地产中的地位。

十四世纪起，奥斯特罗格斯基诸侯掌有扎斯拉夫；家族的一个分支以城镇为姓，称扎斯瓦夫斯基。1673年，地产转归桑古什科家族。波兰被瓜分后，城镇成为俄罗斯帝国的一部分，短暂担任总督辖区中心，十八世纪末成为沃里尼亚的一座辖区城镇。古老的防御工事和教堂令人想起历代城主的权力与资助。

english:
Izium occupies a bend of the Siverskyi Donets, where the river cuts through the hills of the southern forest-steppe. A fortified settlement stood here in the seventeenth century, on a frontier exposed to raids from the steppe. Its position on the river and the defensive line made it an important Cossack centre of Sloboda Ukraine.

In 1681 the Kharkiv Cossack colonel Hryhorii Donets-Zakharshevskyi began a new fortress on the high right bank. From 1685 until 1765 Izium was the seat of its own Sloboda Cossack regiment. Its Transfiguration Cathedral, built in 1684–1685, is an early masonry church of the region, while Saint Nicholas's Church was begun in 1809. The fortress and churches marked the growth of a permanent town out of the military settlements along the Donets.
simp_chinese:
伊久姆位于北顿涅茨河的一处河湾，河流在此穿过南部森林草原的丘陵。十七世纪，这里已有设防聚落，处于容易遭受草原袭击的边疆。河畔及防线上的位置，使它成为斯洛博达乌克兰重要的哥萨克中心。

1681 年，哈尔科夫哥萨克团上校赫里霍里·多涅茨-扎哈尔热夫斯基开始在高耸的右岸修建新堡垒。1685 至 1765 年，伊久姆是同名斯洛博达哥萨克团的驻地。建于 1684—1685 年的救世主显圣容主教座堂是当地早期的砖石教堂，圣尼古拉教堂则于 1809 年动工。堡垒与教堂见证了一座永久城镇从顿涅茨河沿岸军事聚落中成长起来。

english:
Izki was an inland Omani oasis whose old settlement comprised the neighbouring walled towns of al-Nizar and al-Yemen. Their closely placed but distinct enclosures formed a paired urban landscape, with a Yaʿruba fort between them. Al-Yemen underwent destruction and rebuilding during the eighteenth century, leaving a more regular street pattern within the old settlement.

Water ownership was another enduring part of the oasis's organisation. A manuscript register of the Falaj al-Malki, preserved in the Wilkinson papers, records the names and holdings of owners of irrigation-water shares. Its entries span approximately 1825 to 1875, beginning within the early nineteenth century. The notebook preserves the allocation of a resource shared through the irrigation system across successive decades. Town walls, reconstruction and the documentation of water rights together reveal an oasis shaped by the defence of settled space and the administration of its water supply.
simp_chinese:
伊兹基是阿曼内陆绿洲，旧城由相邻的尼扎尔与也门两座围墙聚落组成，二者之间另有雅鲁巴王朝堡垒。这一并列而有区分的城镇景观，在十八世纪经历变化：也门聚落遭破坏后重建，街道布局随之更趋规整。

灌溉水权也是绿洲组织的重要部分。保存在威尔金森文献中的马尔基灌渠手写登记簿，记录水份持有者的姓名与份额，年代约从1825年延续至1875年，起始部分已进入十九世纪前期。登记簿保存了灌溉体系中资源分配跨越数十年的记录。围墙、聚落重建与水权记载，共同呈现出一处重视定居空间防卫及供水管理的绿洲。

english:
İznik stands within ancient walls at the eastern end of the lake that bears its name. As Nicaea, it was one of the great cities of Bithynia and the meeting place of the first ecumenical council in 325, when bishops gathered under Constantine to debate Christian doctrine. Its gates and long circuit of defences frame a city whose streets carry the traces of Roman, Byzantine and Ottoman rule.

After Constantinople fell to the Fourth Crusade in 1204, Nicaea became the centre of a Byzantine successor state. Its rulers recovered Constantinople in 1261, but the city later faced growing Ottoman pressure. Orhan captured it in 1331, making İznik an important town of the early Ottoman realm. Churches were adapted for new uses, while mosques, schools and other endowed buildings gave the town a new civic life.

İznik became celebrated for its pottery and tiles. Workshops developed fine white-bodied ceramics painted beneath a transparent glaze, supplying vessels and architectural decoration for patrons far beyond the town. The ceramic body combined quartz, clay and glass frit, producing a pale surface suited to painted designs. In the sixteenth century their designs and colours adorned major Ottoman buildings. The workshops and the surviving monuments of Nicaea made İznik a place where the artistic achievements of different centuries met within the same ancient walls.
simp_chinese:
伊兹尼克位于同名湖泊东端，古老城墙仍环绕着它。这里古称尼西亚，曾是比提尼亚的重要城市。325 年，君士坦丁召集主教在此举行第一次大公会议，讨论基督教教义。城门和绵延的防御工事围起城市，街道上留下罗马、拜占庭和奥斯曼统治的痕迹。

1204 年第四次十字军攻陷君士坦丁堡后，尼西亚成为拜占庭继承国的中心。其统治者于 1261 年收复君士坦丁堡，但城市后来面临日益增长的奥斯曼压力。1331 年奥尔汗攻占此地，伊兹尼克成为早期奥斯曼国家的重要城镇。教堂被改作新用途，清真寺、学校和其他基金会建筑则赋予城市新的公共生活。

伊兹尼克以陶器和瓷砖闻名。工坊制作白色细胎陶器，在透明釉下彩绘，为远方顾客供应器皿和建筑装饰。陶胎结合石英、黏土和玻璃料，形成适合彩绘的浅色表面。十六世纪，其色彩与纹样装点了奥斯曼的重要建筑。工坊和幸存的尼西亚古迹，使不同时代的艺术成就在同一座古城墙内相遇。

english: Izori stood beside Lake Beloye in the wooded country of the Vodskaya pyatina of Novgorod. The village appears in the land register of 1500 within the Nikolsky Butkovsky churchyard district. The same name was borne by several settlements in Novgorod's lands; its possible connection with the Izhora people has been discussed by scholars. Here the lake and surrounding forests formed the setting of a small rural community under Novgorod's old territorial divisions.
simp_chinese: 伊佐里位于诺夫哥罗德沃茨卡亚五区的林地，坐落在别洛耶湖畔。1500年的土地登记簿将村庄列入尼科利斯基布特科沃教区。诺夫哥罗德领地有数处聚落同名，学者曾讨论这些地名与伊若拉人的可能联系。在这里，湖泊与周围森林构成小型乡村社群的生活环境，也处于诺夫哥罗德旧有的地域划分之内。

english: Iztachacalapan was a settlement in the lowlands of southern Veracruz, on the route toward Acayucan, among the river country and forested plains of the Gulf coast. Its name is linked to a place called Chacalapan. In 1584 Juan de Figueroa requested four cattle properties at the same place, a sign that colonial land claims had reached a landscape with a much older Indigenous history.
simp_chinese: 伊斯塔查卡拉潘是韦拉克鲁斯南部低地的一处聚落，位于通向阿卡尤坎的道路上，坐落在墨西哥湾沿岸的河流与森林平原之间。其名称与一处名为查卡拉潘的地方相联系。1584年，胡安·德菲格罗亚在同一地点申请四处牧牛地产，显示殖民土地占有已进入一片拥有更早原住民历史的地区。

english:
The Izu Islands stretch southward from the Izu Peninsula into the Pacific. The traditional seven are Oshima, Toshima, Niijima, Kozushima, Miyakejima, Mikurajima and Hachijojima. Their scattered volcanic land offered very different resources from the rice plains of the mainland, while sea crossings tied island communities to Japanese ports. Under the Tokugawa shogunate, Niijima, Miyakejima and Hachijojima were places of penal exile.

Hachijojima received Ukita Hideie in 1606 after his defeat on the losing side at Sekigahara. Another exile, Kondo Tomizo, arrived in 1827 and later compiled the Hachijo Jikki, an extensive account of island life. Exile was only one part of an economy shaped by food shortages and obligations to the mainland. Hachijo silk, especially the cloth known as kihachijo, served in payment of taxes in place of rice; cloth was also required to repay grain advanced during shortages. In 1796 an island-products exchange was established at Teppozu in Edo. Island households thus faced both the hazards of maritime supply and the demands of a government and market far across the water.
simp_chinese:
伊豆诸岛从伊豆半岛向南伸入太平洋。传统所称七岛包括大岛、利岛、新岛、神津岛、三宅岛、御藏岛和八丈岛。分散的火山岛所提供的资源与本州稻作平原大不相同，海路却始终把岛民同日本港口相连。德川幕府统治下，新岛、三宅岛和八丈岛都是流刑之地。

关原战败的宇喜多秀家于1606年被流放八丈岛。另一名流人近藤富藏于1827年抵岛，后来编纂详细记述海岛生活的《八丈实记》。流放只是地方经济的一部分，粮食短缺及对本州的义务同样深刻地影响居民。八丈绢、尤其黄八丈织物，代替稻米缴纳贡税；饥荒时借入粮食，也须以织物偿还。1796年，江户铁炮洲设立岛屿物产交易会所。岛民既要面对跨海补给的风险，也要承担远在海那边的政府和市场提出的要求。

english:
The Izumi country around Fuchu and its neighbouring valleys contained temples, villages and wooded hills whose rights were repeatedly negotiated during the unification wars. In 1577 Oda Nobunaga prohibited military disorder, felling and arson at Matsuoji. Four years later his forces destroyed the temple and confiscated its lands; documents and a religious painting were carried to other communities for safekeeping.

The surveys of 1594 separated temple holdings, exempt woodland and taxable fields along the eastern Matsuo River. Toyotomi Hideyori subsequently supported the revival of local religious sites, including rebuilding Makio-san's main hall in 1603 and the Shinoda shrine buildings in 1604. Village affairs continued alongside these powerful patrons. In 1611 Mancho, Urata and Kajiya reached an agreement on the rotation of irrigation water from Nashimoto Pond. After 1615 the Matsuo valley villages became shogunal land. Such records show how warfare and rebuilding affected the management of fields, forests and water in this part of Izumi.
simp_chinese:
府中及周边河谷的和泉地区分布着寺院、村落与山林，统一战争期间，相关权利多次调整。1577年，织田信长禁止军队在松尾寺滋扰、砍树和纵火；四年后，其军队却毁坏寺院、没收寺领，文书与宗教画被转移到其他社群保存。

1594年的检地划分了寺院领地、免税山林和东松尾川沿线纳税田地。丰臣秀赖后来支持当地寺社复兴，包括1603年重建槙尾山本堂、1604年重建信太神社建筑。村落事务也在权势更替间持续：1611年，万町、浦田与锻冶屋就梨本池轮流供水订立协议。1615年后，松尾谷诸村成为幕府领地。这些记录具体呈现了战乱与重建如何影响和泉当地的田地、山林与水利管理。

english:
Izumi lay at the northern entrance to Satsuma, facing the approaches from Higo. Its medieval history was shaped by competing warrior families. In 1354–1355, fighting between the Shimazu and the local Izumi lineage centred on Ozaki and Kimure castles. During the following century, divisions within the Shimazu again brought conflict to the district; Kimure fell in 1422 as the rival Sōshū branch was defeated.

Under the early modern Satsuma domain, Izumi retained a special strategic importance as a gateway on the border. Its fumoto settlement housed samurai and their families, combining military obligations with farming. This was part of a wider system of dispersed warrior communities rather than a concentration of all retainers in Kagoshima. After the Shimazu defeat at Sekigahara in 1600, the family's lands were confirmed in 1602. Izumi's subsequent role as a northern stronghold therefore developed within a domain whose survival had been secured under the Tokugawa settlement.
simp_chinese:
出水位于萨摩北部入口，面向肥后方向的通路。中世纪，当地历史受到多个武士家族竞争的影响。1354至1355年，岛津氏与地方和泉氏之间的战斗，以尾崎城及木牟礼城为中心。此后一世纪，岛津内部的分裂再次将战事带到这里；1422年，木牟礼城失守，敌对的总州家败亡。

近世萨摩藩体制下，出水作为边界门户仍有特殊战略地位。麓聚落容纳武士及其家眷，武职义务与耕作生活相结合。这属于分散的武士社区体系，家臣并非全部集中于鹿儿岛。岛津氏在1600年关原之战失利后，于1602年获确认保有领地。出水此后作为北方据点的作用，便是在德川政权安排下得以延续的萨摩藩中发展起来的。

english:
Izumo's great shrine underwent repeated rebuilding, supported by priests, military rulers and worshippers far beyond the province. In 1609 its main sanctuary was reconstructed with stone foundations replacing the earlier earthfast pillars. Buddhist buildings also stood within the precinct, reflecting the combination of religious practices that had developed around the shrine during the medieval centuries.

The reconstruction of 1667 followed negotiations with the Tokugawa authorities. The shogunate contributed funds, and a main sanctuary about twenty-four metres high restored a larger architectural form. Buddhist structures were transferred to neighbouring temples during the same undertaking. Another rebuilding produced the sanctuary of 1744. With government assistance initially uncertain, shrine personnel obtained permission to travel through domains, conduct rites and collect donations from towns and villages. The completed building followed the 1667 arrangement. Izumo's religious centre was therefore sustained through renewed construction, official permission and networks of patronage that connected its local precinct with communities across Japan.
simp_chinese:
出云大社反复营建，赞助来自神职、武家统治者及远方信众。1609年重建本殿时，柱下改用基石，取代较早的掘立柱。境内还设佛堂、三重塔等，体现中古时期神佛习合的宗教实践。

1667年营建经过与德川当局交涉，幕府捐资修筑约二十四米高的本殿，恢复较大的建筑形式；同时，境内佛教设施移交邻寺。1744年的本殿重建又承袭1667年布局。因官方资助起初难以确定，神职获准巡行各藩，在城乡奉行仪礼并募捐。出云的宗教中心因此依靠持续营建、官方许可及赞助网络维持，将地方神域连接到日本各地社群。

english: Izyaslavl was a small town on the southern edge of the Smolensk lands, commonly identified with the site near the later village of Seslavl. A charter of the early thirteenth century lists it among places paying dues to the bishop of Smolensk. By 1503 the district appears as Vseslavl among lands transferred to Moscow, suggesting that the old town had become a rural centre. Its location placed it between Roslavl and the Desna country.
simp_chinese: 伊贾斯拉夫尔是斯摩棱斯克诸地南缘的一座小城，通常被认为位于后来谢斯拉夫尔村附近。13世纪初的文书将它列为向斯摩棱斯克主教缴纳贡赋的地点之一。到1503年，这一地区以弗谢斯拉夫尔之名出现在转归莫斯科的土地中，说明古城可能已成为乡村中心。它位于罗斯拉夫尔与杰斯纳河地区之间。

english:
Jindřichův Hradec stands on the Nežárka beside the Vajgar pond in southern Bohemia. Its name recalls Jindřich of the Vítkovci family, who built a Gothic castle on the site of an older Slavic stronghold around 1220. A settlement grew beside the castle and became the seat of the lords of Hradec, whose residence and estates shaped the town for centuries.

Under the last members of the Hradec family in the late sixteenth century, the town reached the height of its development. Gothic houses and the castle were rebuilt in Renaissance style, and settlement spread beyond the walls. After the Thirty Years' War it remained one of the largest towns in Bohemia, although its political and economic importance later declined. Great fires in 1773 and 1801 damaged many houses and prompted further rebuilding.
simp_chinese:
因德日赫城位于南波希米亚的内扎尔卡河畔，毗邻瓦伊加尔池塘。城名令人想起维特科夫采家族的因德日赫，他约在一二二〇年于古老斯拉夫堡寨原址上建起哥特式城堡。聚落在堡旁成长，并成为赫拉德茨领主的驻地；他们的宅邸和庄园数百年来影响着城镇。

十六世纪末，在赫拉德茨家族最后几代成员统治下，城镇达到发展高峰。哥特式住宅与城堡改建为文艺复兴风格，聚落扩展至城墙之外。三十年战争后，这里仍是波希米亚最大的城镇之一，但政治与经济地位后来逐渐下降。一七七三年和一八〇一年的大火损坏许多房屋，居民又进行了重建。

english: Jääsjärvi is a lake in the Finnish interior whose name means “ice lake.” Its clear waters contain dozens of islands, among them Vehkasalo, Hirtesalo and Ohrasaari. The Tainionvirta flows out of the lake and passes through smaller lakes on its way to Päijänne, joining Jääsjärvi to the wider waters of the Kymijoki basin. In winter the lake usually freezes, changing the character of its many shores and channels.
simp_chinese: 亚斯湖是芬兰内陆的一座湖泊，其芬兰语名称意为“冰湖”。清澈的湖水中有数十座岛屿，包括韦赫卡萨洛、希尔特萨洛和奥赫拉萨里。泰尼翁河从湖中流出，穿过数座小湖后汇入派耶讷湖，使亚斯湖成为屈米河流域水网的一部分。冬季湖面通常会结冰，众多湖岸与水道也随之换上一番模样。

english:
Jaʿbar stood on a hill beside the middle Euphrates west of Raqqa. By the fourteenth century its impressive walls and minaret belonged to a fortress whose greatest days had already passed. Mongol forces had devastated it in 1260, dispersing its inhabitants. The Mamluk sultan al-Nasir Muhammad repaired the castle in 1336, immediately before this period, but substantial urban settlement did not return.

Arab and Turkoman groups used the site and its surroundings as seasonal quarters. Under the Mamluks, clans of the Döger occupied the district within the jurisdiction of Aleppo, and their local influence continued under Ottoman rule. The castle thus survived within a landscape shaped by mobile communities as well as imperial administration. A nearby grave also acquired a lasting place in Ottoman historical tradition through its association with Süleyman Shah, although the identity of the person buried there remains disputed.
simp_chinese:
贾巴尔位于拉卡以西、幼发拉底河中游河畔的山丘上。到十四世纪，醒目的城墙与宣礼塔已属于一座盛期过去的堡垒。1260年蒙古军队破坏城堡，居民四散。马穆鲁克苏丹纳西尔·穆罕默德于1336年、这一时期开始前夕修复了它，但此后并未恢复规模可观的城市聚落。

阿拉伯与土库曼群体把城堡及周围地区用作季节性驻地。马穆鲁克时期，都格尔部族的一些支系居住于此，行政上隶属阿勒颇，其地方影响延续到奥斯曼统治之下。因此，城堡所在的地域同时受到流动社群与帝国行政的塑造。附近一座墓葬又因被附会为苏莱曼沙之墓，在奥斯曼历史传统中获得长久地位，不过墓主的身份一直存在争议。

english: Jabar Goemba is a Buddhist monastery in the mountain country of western Bhutan. It was founded by Lama Drakpa Jamtsho in a valley surrounded by five mountains, whose shapes were likened to the five ritual hats worn by lamas. The monastery’s treasured phurba, a ritual dagger, is said in local tradition to have flown there from Tibet. The shrine belongs to a landscape of monasteries and sacred places in the valleys between Bhutan’s highlands and southern foothills.
simp_chinese: 贾巴尔贡巴是不丹西部山地的一座佛教寺院，由喇嘛扎巴嘉措建立。寺院所在的山谷被五座山环绕，人们认为山形仿佛喇嘛所戴的五种法帽，十分吉祥。寺院珍藏的普巴杵是一种法器；地方传说称它从西藏飞到了这里。这座寺院是连接不丹高地与南部山麓的山谷中众多寺庙和圣地之一。

english: Al-Jabbul lies beside a great salt lake southeast of Aleppo. Rain and streams from the surrounding valleys gather in the shallow basin, whose salty ground has long supplied the prized Jabbuli salt. Reeds fringe parts of the wetland, and migratory waterbirds rest and feed there. The salt lake and the cultivated country around it form a distinctive landscape on the edge of the Syrian steppe.
simp_chinese: 杰布勒位于阿勒颇东南方的大盐湖旁。降雨和周围河谷的水流汇入浅盆，盐碱地长期出产著名的杰布勒盐。湿地部分边缘生长芦苇，迁徙水鸟在此停歇觅食。盐湖与周围耕地构成叙利亚草原边缘独特的景观。

english:
Jabhua corresponds to Jhabua in western Malwa, a country of Bhil communities and Rathor chiefs near the approaches to Gujarat. The Rathor state is conventionally dated to 1584 and associated with Kesho Das, whose service connected the ruling family to the Mughal court. The dynasty's establishment did not erase the authority of local Nayaks: its history includes struggles over Jhabua and nearby Thandla as well as grants from distant emperors.

After Kesho Das died in 1618, his estates were attached by the Mughal government. Shah Jahan restored them to his nephew Maha Singh in 1642, but Maha Singh had to defeat the Nayaks of Jhabua and Thandla before re-establishing his capital at Jhabua. During the eighteenth century Maratha power narrowed the state's freedom of action. Holkar occupied Petlawad and Thandla in 1730, illustrating how individual districts could pass away from the Rathor ruler without ending the dynasty itself. Jhabua's early modern history thus rests on specific contests among Bhil chiefs, Rajput rulers, Mughal patrons and Maratha neighbors, rather than on an unchanging frontier beyond imperial government.
simp_chinese:
贾布阿对应西摩腊婆的杰布阿，位于通往古吉拉特的地带，地方社会包含比尔社群与拉索尔首领。拉索尔邦通常被认为始于1584年，创建者为克绍·达斯；他的军职把统治家族同莫卧儿宫廷联系起来。王朝建立并未消除地方纳亚克首领的权力，邦国历史既有来自皇帝的授地，也有围绕杰布阿和邻近坦德拉展开的争夺。

克绍·达斯于1618年去世后，其领地被莫卧儿政府收回。1642年，沙贾汗将这些土地交还其侄马哈·辛格，但后者仍须击败杰布阿与坦德拉的纳亚克，才能重新在杰布阿建立首府。十八世纪，马拉塔势力逐步压缩邦国的自主空间。霍尔卡尔于1730年占据佩特拉瓦德和坦德拉，表明个别地区可以脱离拉索尔统治，而王朝本身仍继续存在。这一地方史由比尔首领、拉其普特统治者、莫卧儿保护者和马拉塔邻国间的具体竞争构成。

english: Jabirr Jabirr country lies on the western side of the Dampier Peninsula in the Kimberley. It stretches from the Sandy Point area at Beagle Bay south towards Cape Bertholet. The Jabirr Jabirr are an Aboriginal people of this coastal country, neighbouring the Nyulnyul to the north and other communities inland.
simp_chinese: 贾比尔贾比尔人的土地位于金伯利丹皮尔半岛西侧，从比格尔湾桑迪角地区向南延伸至贝索莱角。贾比尔贾比尔人是这片沿海土地的原住民，北方与纽尔纽尔人相邻，内陆还有其他社群。

english:
Jabiyan, also written Jiefan or Jaifiyan, was a fortified Jurchen site on Tiebei Mountain near the meeting of the Hun and Suzi rivers. Before Nurhaci united the surrounding communities, a stockade here belonged to the Jecen group. The later stronghold followed the mountain ridges, with an inner enclosure and eastern and western defensive sections. Steep slopes and nearby rivers protected its approaches.

In 1619 the Later Jin mobilised labour to build the fortress. Construction coincided with the battle of Sarhu, when Ming troops approaching the works encountered Jurchen defenders and the forces coming to reinforce them. After the victory, Nurhaci moved his residence and household to Jiefan, bringing his political centre closer to the Ming frontier. Its role as a capital was brief: in 1620 he moved again, to nearby Sarhu. The surviving site includes substantial building foundations associated with the ruler's residence, together with finds of armour plates, iron projectiles and porcelain fragments.
simp_chinese:
扎比延亦称界凡、界藩，是浑河与苏子河交汇处附近铁背山上的女真城寨。努尔哈赤统一周边社群之前，这里属于哲陈部。后来的山城循山脊展开，分内城及东西卫城，陡坡与河流共同护卫通路。

1619年，后金征发劳力筑城，工程进行时发生萨尔浒之战，逼近工地的明军与守城女真人及赶来增援的部队交战。获胜后，努尔哈赤将居所和家眷迁入界凡，使政治中心更加靠近明朝边境。其都城地位十分短暂：1620年，他再次迁往附近的萨尔浒。遗址保留与统治者居所相联系的大型房屋基址，还发现铁甲片、铁弹丸和瓷器残片。山城的修筑与迅速迁弃，反映后金战争重心向辽东腹地推进的过程。

english: Jableh stands on the Mediterranean coast south of Latakia, where an ancient Roman theatre recalls its long history as a port. The town was part of the Principality of Antioch during the Crusades until Saladin captured it in 1189. Near the theatre stands a mosque and shrine associated with Ibrahim ibn Adham, an early Muslim ascetic. A Seljuk-era tomb was joined to a Mamluk prayer hall, and Ottoman builders later added domes to the complex.
simp_chinese: 贾布莱位于拉塔基亚以南的地中海岸，古罗马剧场令人想起这座港口悠久的历史。十字军时期，它属于安条克公国，直至一一八九年被萨拉丁攻占。剧场附近有一座与早期穆斯林苦行者易卜拉欣·本·阿德海姆有关的清真寺和圣陵。塞尔柱时代的墓室后来与马穆鲁克礼拜厅相连，奥斯曼建筑者又为建筑群增添穹顶。

english:
Jaboticabal's settlement history reaches the closing decades of the period through the wooded interior of São Paulo. On 27 April 1820, João Pinto Ferreira acquired land from João Rodrigues Lima beside the Cachoeira stream, in the sertão of Araraquara. The tract measured one league across its frontage and three in depth. Ferreira established a farm first called Cachoeira and later Pintos.

In 1828, beside the Cerradinho and Jaboticabal streams, he began laying out a settlement around a chapel dedicated to Our Lady of Mount Carmel on 16 July. The chapel provided the nucleus for the later town. Water from the two streams, the fertile ground and the hill between them helped attract inhabitants. At this stage the locality remained a new rural settlement within the Araraquara hinterland. The farm, chapel and adjacent waterways formed the setting of its early growth, preceding the parish and municipal institutions that would develop later in the nineteenth century.
simp_chinese:
雅博蒂卡巴尔的建村史，在游戏时段末期才进入圣保罗内陆林地的记录。1820年4月27日，若昂·平托·费雷拉从若昂·罗德里格斯·利马手中取得阿拉拉夸拉荒野、卡舒埃拉溪畔的一块土地，临边宽一里格、纵深三里格。他在此建立农场，最初称卡舒埃拉，后来称平托斯。

1828年，他在塞拉迪纽溪与雅博蒂卡巴尔溪旁开始营建居民点，其中心小礼拜堂于7月16日奉献给加尔默罗圣母。教堂成为后来城镇的核心，两条溪流提供的水源、肥沃土地及其间的丘陵共同吸引居民。此时当地仍是阿拉拉夸拉内陆新兴的乡村聚落。农场、礼拜堂与邻近水道构成早期发展的环境，十九世纪后期的堂区和市镇机构尚未形成。

english: Jaburrara, or Yaburara, country includes Murujuga and the islands of the Dampier Archipelago on the Pilbara coast. The dark rocks bear a remarkable wealth of engravings, from human figures to fish and other animals. On Angel Island, an image of a thylacine recalls a marsupial that vanished from the Australian mainland long before European ships reached these shores.
simp_chinese: 贾布拉拉又称亚布拉拉，其土地包括皮尔巴拉海岸的穆鲁朱加和丹皮尔群岛。深色岩石上刻有数量惊人的图像，从人物到鱼类及其他动物皆有。天使岛上的一幅袋狼岩刻令人想起这种有袋动物：早在欧洲船只抵达海岸之前，它便已从澳大利亚大陆消失。

sources.title: 192000681 20200629 Murajuga Rock Art Annual Report - new.pdf

english:
Jacareí grew beside the Paraíba do Sul in southeastern Brazil, along routes linking the coast with inland settlements. Local histories associate its beginnings with Antonio Afonso and his three sons, who settled there in 1652 under the name Nossa Senhora da Conceição da Paraíba. It became a vila in 1653, and the creation document was drawn up in November of that year.

The river and the roads toward Minas Gerais made the settlement a stopping place for muleteers and travellers. Religious buildings marked its developing centre, including the Avarei chapel dated to 1728. From around 1790 the spread of coffee cultivation in the Paraíba valley brought a new source of commercial growth, and by the early nineteenth century Jacareí was an established river-valley town shaped by local farming, inland traffic and the emerging coffee economy.
simp_chinese:
雅卡雷伊在巴西东南部的南帕拉伊巴河畔发展起来，处于沿海与内陆聚落之间的通路上。地方史将它的开端追溯至1652年安东尼奥·阿丰索及其三个儿子在此定居，最初名为帕拉伊巴圣母无染原罪聚落。1653年，它升为市镇；创建文书写于当年十一月。

河流以及通往米纳斯吉拉斯的道路，使这里成为驮队和旅人的歇脚处。宗教建筑标示出聚落中心的发展，其中阿瓦雷伊小教堂可追溯至1728年。约自1790年起，帕拉伊巴河谷咖啡种植的扩张为当地商业带来新的动力，进入十九世纪初时，雅卡雷伊已是一处由农业、内陆交通和新兴咖啡经济共同塑造的河谷市镇。

english:
Jáchal was a settled religious centre before the Spanish colonial town was formally laid out. A chapel stood in the valley of Jáchal de Angacao by 1616. An image of Saint Joseph, brought from Upper Peru in 1690, became associated with the community and was later recognised in the founding act as its patron and protector.

Juan de Echegaray founded the villa in 1751. He assigned a plot facing the main square for its church, which opened in 1785. The arrangement gave the new town a public centre where the square and parish faced one another. Religious life also provided a setting for political change: on 15 August 1816 the inhabitants and local authorities swore allegiance to the independence proclaimed at Tucumán in the parish room. Jáchal's colonial history therefore survives in a sequence of chapel, planned town and civic ceremony. The church building now standing belongs to a later nineteenth-century reconstruction; its present appearance should not be projected back onto these earlier events.
simp_chinese:
哈查尔在西班牙殖民城镇正式规划以前，已是有礼拜活动的聚居地。1616年，哈查尔德安加考谷地已有一座小教堂。1690年从上秘鲁带来的圣若瑟像逐渐成为当地信仰的中心，后来建镇文书又将圣若瑟确认为城镇的主保与守护者。

1751年，胡安·德埃切加赖建立城镇，在主广场对面划出教堂用地，新堂于1785年启用。广场与教区相对，形成城镇公共生活的中心。宗教场所也见证了政局转变：1816年8月15日，居民和地方官员在教区房间宣誓拥护图库曼宣布的独立。小堂、规划城镇和政治仪式，构成这里殖民时期历史的一条清晰脉络。今日所见教堂属于十九世纪较晚时期的重建，不能把现存建筑的外观直接套用于早年的这些事件。

english:
Jáchymov, known in German as Joachimsthal, grew around rich silver deposits in the Ore Mountains. Steffan Schlick founded the settlement in 1516, four years after silver was found, and its rapid growth enriched his family. Coins struck from the local silver were called Joachimsthalers; their shortened name, thaler, would eventually give rise to the word dollar. By 1534 the mining town was second only to Prague in population within Bohemia.

Ferdinand I seized the mining rights from the Schlicks in 1528. The town's mines and smelting works attracted the physician Georgius Agricola, whose observations informed his pioneering studies of metallurgy. Protestantism took root, but the restoration of Catholicism in 1621 drove many Lutheran inhabitants toward Saxony. Warfare, difficulty pumping water from deep mines and competition from Spanish American silver weakened the industry.
simp_chinese:
亚希莫夫的德语名为约阿希姆斯塔尔，因厄尔士山脉丰富的银矿而兴起。一五一二年当地发现白银，四年后施特凡·施利克建立聚落，迅速发展的采矿业使其家族富裕起来。当地银币称为约阿希姆斯塔勒，简称塔勒，后来又衍生出“美元”一词。一五三四年，这座矿业城镇的人口在波希米亚仅次于布拉格。

一五二八年，费迪南德一世从施利克家族手中夺取采矿权。当地矿山和冶炼厂吸引了医生格奥尔格·阿格里科拉，他的观察成为开创性冶金研究的基础。新教在此扎根，但一六二一年恢复天主教后，许多路德宗居民迁往萨克森。战争、深井排水困难以及西属美洲白银的竞争，削弱了当地矿业。

english:
The waters off Jacmel served a port on the southern coast of Hispaniola. In 1698, the French Compagnie de Saint-Domingue established a trading settlement on the site of an earlier Indigenous village. The colonial town developed around export commerce, with a street plan adapted to the slopes behind the shore. Fortifications, including the Petite Batterie and Fort Béliot, guarded the entrance to its roadstead.

The port connected the coast with the coffee-producing hinterland of French Saint-Domingue, whose plantation economy depended on enslaved labour. Revolutionary warfare disrupted those connections. Jacmel endured repeated sieges during the struggles of 1791–1803, and its harbour remained important after Haitian independence. The wider story of these coastal waters therefore includes both the movement of plantation exports and the armed contests that transformed the colony. Ships approaching Jacmel entered a roadstead defended from the shore, where the commercial routes of the eighteenth century became entangled with the creation of an independent Haitian state.
simp_chinese:
雅克梅尔外海服务于伊斯帕尼奥拉岛南岸的一处港口。1698年，法国圣多明各公司在较早原住民村落旧址建立贸易聚落。殖民城镇围绕出口商业发展，街道格局适应岸后坡地；小炮台与贝利奥堡等防御设施守卫锚地入口。

港口将海岸与法属圣多明各的咖啡产区相连，种植园经济依赖被奴役者劳动。革命战争打断这些联系，雅克梅尔在1791至1803年的斗争中屡遭围攻，海港在海地独立后仍有重要作用。这片沿海水域的历史因而包括种植园产品运输，以及改变殖民地的武装争夺。驶来船只进入由岸上设防的锚地，十八世纪商业路线也在这里卷入海地独立国家形成的过程。

english:
Jacquinot Bay lies on the southern coast of New Britain. Its appearance in European charts came late in the period, and the history of that naming should be separated from the much older presence of island communities. European voyages provide dated observations of the coast, rather than a starting point for human occupation.

William Dampier sailed along southern New Britain in February 1700 after establishing that the island was separate from New Guinea. He named Cape Orford, but poor visibility meant that his log recorded no particular features in the Jacquinot Bay area. In July 1827 Dumont d'Urville's Astrolabe also sighted the southern coast. His expedition mapped part of it and named the bay after Charles-Hector Jacquinot, the second-in-command. These encounters placed the area within an expanding European geographical record. They establish a history of passing ships, observation and chart-making, without demonstrating that the bay's inhabitants had accepted foreign authority or that a colonial station already existed there.
simp_chinese:
雅基诺湾位于新不列颠岛南岸，直到本时期较晚阶段才进入欧洲海图。其命名史应同岛屿社群更早的存在分别理解。欧洲航行提供了可以定年的海岸观察记录，并非人类居住史的起点。

1700年2月，威廉·丹皮尔确认新不列颠同新几内亚分离后，沿其南岸航行。他命名奥福德角，但能见度不佳，航海日志没有记录雅基诺湾一带的具体地貌。1827年7月，迪蒙·迪维尔的星盘号也望见南岸。远征队测绘其中一部分，并以副指挥官夏尔—埃克托尔·雅基诺命名海湾。这些接触将当地纳入日益扩展的欧洲地理记录，确立了过往船舶、观察与制图的历史；它们不能证明湾区居民接受了外国权威，也不能证明当地已设殖民据点。

sources.title: Nakanai Mountains ENB FINAL V.2 June 2022.pdf

english: Jacu is a rapid on the Parnaíba River above Uruçuí, in the interior of northeastern Brazil. The Parnaíba flows north between the lands of Piauí and Maranhão, receiving tributaries from both sides. Rapids such as Jacu interrupt its course and distinguish the upper river from the more navigable stretches downstream. Along its banks, wooded country and seasonal waterways form part of the great basin that ultimately reaches the Atlantic.
simp_chinese: 雅库是巴西东北内陆帕尔纳伊巴河上的一处急流，位于乌鲁苏伊上游。帕尔纳伊巴河在皮奥伊与马拉尼昂之间向北流淌，接纳两岸支流。雅库等急流打断河道，使上游有别于下游较易航行的河段。河岸的林地与季节性水道属于这一广阔流域，河水最终注入大西洋。

english:
The Jacuí country here belongs to Rio Grande do Sul, where the river joined the southern Brazilian grasslands to the waterways leading towards Porto Alegre. It should be distinguished from the town of Jacuí in Minas Gerais. One documented point in this river landscape was Rio Pardo, near the junction of the Pardo and Jacuí rivers.

After Portugal and Spain signed the Treaty of Madrid in 1750, Portuguese soldiers established a frontier commission beside the Jacuí. A fort called Jesus-Maria-José became the nucleus of a settlement of soldiers' families, livestock drovers, merchants and Azorean settlers. The river port received goods from Porto Alegre for distribution towards the missions, the pampa and the uplands. In 1809 Rio Pardo became one of the four municipalities into which the captaincy was divided. These events describe a particular river junction and its hinterland, not the foundation of every settlement throughout the Jacuí basin.
simp_chinese:
此处雅库伊属于南里奥格兰德，河流把巴西南部草原与通向阿雷格里港的水路连接起来，需要与米纳斯吉拉斯的同名城镇区别。帕尔杜河与雅库伊河汇合处附近的里奥帕尔杜，是这片河流景观中有具体历史记录的节点。

1750年葡萄牙与西班牙签订《马德里条约》后，葡方士兵在雅库伊河畔设置边界委员会。耶稣—玛利亚—若瑟堡逐渐成为聚落核心，居民包括军人家属、赶牲畜者、商人及亚速尔移民。河港接收来自阿雷格里港的货物，转运至传教区、草原和山地。1809年，里奥帕尔杜成为该都督区划分出的四个市镇之一。这些事件说明特定汇流点及其腹地的变化，不能当作整个雅库伊流域所有聚落的共同创建史。

english:
Jade Bay opens onto the North Sea in northwestern Germany, on a coast repeatedly remade by storm floods. Before the great medieval incursions, much of the area was low ground with peat bogs and scattered higher islands. The Second Marcellus Flood of 1362 destroyed villages and enlarged the inlet westward. Further disasters culminated in the flood of 1511, when the bay reached its greatest extent.

Afterward, improvements in the organization and construction of dikes gradually allowed reclamation to exceed the loss of land. Embankments of the sixteenth and seventeenth centuries reduced the bay toward its later outline, transforming former tidal ground into protected country. Around 1700 most of the shore was enclosed, but a difficult gap remained on the southeastern side between Schweiburg and Hobenbrake. Under Christian Thomesen Sehestedt, the Oldenburg governor serving the Danish crown, this final gap was closed between 1721 and 1725. Part of the surviving raised bog was left outside the dike. The bay's early modern history was therefore written through specific losses, new embankments and the difficult work of holding a boundary between land and sea.
simp_chinese:
亚德湾位于德国西北部北海岸，沿岸地形反复受到风暴潮改造。中世纪海水大规模侵入以前，这里多为泥炭沼泽与零散高地组成的低地。1362年的第二次马塞勒斯洪灾摧毁村庄，使海湾向西扩展；后续灾害延续至1511年，海湾在当年的风暴潮后达到最大范围。

此后，筑堤技术与组织能力提高，围垦取得的土地逐渐超过海潮侵蚀的损失。十六、十七世纪的新堤将海湾缩减至接近后来的轮廓，把部分潮间地变为受保护土地。约1700年，大部分岸线已有堤防，但东南侧施韦堡至霍本布拉克之间仍留下难以封闭的缺口。为丹麦王室治理奥尔登堡的克里斯蒂安·托梅森·塞赫施泰特主持工程，于1721至1725年间封闭最后缺口；一部分残存高位泥炭地则被留在堤外。近世海湾的历史，具体体现于失去的土地、新筑的堤防，以及维持海陆界线的艰难劳动。

english: Jadliaura is a recorded name for the Yardliyawara people of South Australia. Their traditional country lies in the northern Flinders Ranges, a region of rugged hills and dry watercourses. Yardliyawara people are associated with the wider Adnyamathanha grouping of Aboriginal peoples of the ranges.
simp_chinese: 贾德利奥拉是南澳大利亚亚德利亚瓦拉人的记载名称。其传统土地位于弗林德斯山脉北部，这里山岭崎岖、水道干旱。亚德利亚瓦拉人与山脉中更广泛的阿德尼亚马塔纳原住民族群有关。

english: Jadu is a mountain settlement in the Nafusa range of western Libya. The range's Amazigh-speaking communities made it an important centre of Ibadi Islam, with ties to other Ibadi communities in the M'zab and on Djerba. Along the escarpment, villages overlook the plains and the routes between Tripoli and the Saharan interior.
simp_chinese: 贾杜是利比亚西部奈富塞山脉中的一座山地聚落。山中的阿马齐格语社群使这一地区成为伊巴德派伊斯兰的重要中心，并与姆扎卜、杰尔巴的伊巴德派社群保持联系。沿陡崖分布的村落俯瞰平原，以及的黎波里与撒哈拉内陆之间的道路。

english: Jâ'é ãâyá is the Chiricahua Apache name for Chihuahua, in the dry uplands where the Sacramento and Chuvíscar rivers meet. Concho communities lived in this river country before the Spanish mining town developed. The mission of Nombre de Dios stood nearby and was recorded as a dependent village of Santa Isabel in 1694. A few years later, rich discoveries at Santa Eulalia drew miners to the region, and in 1709 a new settlement was established in the valley below the mines.
simp_chinese: 贾埃阿亚是奇里卡瓦阿帕奇语中奇瓦瓦的名称，这里位于萨克拉门托河与丘维斯卡尔河交汇的干燥高地。西班牙矿镇发展起来以前，孔乔社群已生活在这片河流地区。附近的诺姆布雷德迪奥斯传教站在1694年被记为圣伊萨贝尔所属村落。数年后，圣欧拉利亚发现丰富矿藏，矿工纷纷来到这一地区；1709年，矿区下方的谷地建立了新聚落。

english:
Jaén lies below the ridge of Santa Catalina in the olive country of the upper Guadalquivir. Ferdinand III of Castile took the city in 1246 after the sieges of 1225 and 1230, and Jaén became the head of its own kingdom and the main base for the Castilian war against Granada until 1492. Enrique II gave it many privileges, and under Enrique IV the constable Miguel Lucas de Iranzo made it his seat and obtained the right for its banner to lead those of the kingdom.

The cathedral stood on the site of the principal mosque, which served as a church until Bishop Nicolás de Biedma replaced it with a Gothic building in 1368; the diocesan synod of 1492 ordered collection boxes in every parish to pay for rebuilding, and a survey in 1525 warned that its tower might collapse. The Renaissance project was designed by Andrés de Vandelvira from around 1551; the sacristy was completed in 1577, the crossing and dome for the consecration of 1660, and the façade in 1688. The cathedral keeps the relic of the Holy Face. The Fuente de los Caños was built in 1558 and the Royal Economic Society of Friends of the Country of the city and kingdom of Jaén was created in 1786.
simp_chinese:
哈恩位于上瓜达尔基维尔河橄榄产区的圣卡塔利娜山脊下。卡斯蒂利亚的费尔南多三世在1225年和1230年两次围城之后，于1246年夺取该城，哈恩成为自己王国的首府，直到1492年一直是卡斯蒂利亚对格拉纳达作战的主要基地。恩里克二世给了它许多特权；恩里克四世时期，总管米格尔·卢卡斯·德·伊兰索以此为驻地，并使哈恩的旗帜取得了在王国诸旗中居首的权利。

主教座堂建在主清真寺原址上，清真寺一直作教堂使用，直到主教尼古拉斯·德·比埃德马于1368年用哥特式建筑取代它；1492年教区会议下令各堂区设置募捐箱以资助重建，1525年的检查则警告塔楼可能倒塌。文艺复兴式工程由安德烈斯·德·万德尔维拉设计，约在1551年开工；圣器室1577年完工，交叉处和穹顶赶在1660年祝圣前建成，正立面完成于1688年。主教座堂保存着圣容圣物。卡尼奥斯喷泉建于1558年，哈恩城与王国的皇家祖国之友经济协会于1786年成立。

english: Jæren's coastal farms stood among fields, natural meadows, heath and bogs. At Grødaland, buildings from the early eighteenth to the early nineteenth century preserve a record of this rural landscape. Oats were an important crop; potatoes joined them from the end of the eighteenth century, and farms also kept cattle and sheep. Grødaland's low houses were arranged to resist northwesterly gales. Stone, turf and cladding protected their wooden walls from damp, while roofs were covered with turf or imported Dutch tiles.
simp_chinese: 耶伦的沿海农场分布在田地、天然草甸、石楠荒地和沼泽之间。格勒达兰保存着十八世纪初至十九世纪初的建筑，记录了当地乡村景观。燕麦是重要作物，十八世纪末又开始种植马铃薯，农场也饲养牛羊。格勒达兰的低矮房屋通过排列方式抵挡西北风，石块、草皮与覆板保护木墙免受潮湿侵袭，屋顶则使用草皮或荷兰进口瓦片。

english: Chaeryŏng lies amid the broad lowlands of Hwanghae, where rivers drain the fertile plain toward the western sea. The Chaeryŏng plain extends across several neighbouring districts and has long been known for its rice, which was presented to the royal household. South of the lowlands, Mount Changsu rises above valleys and temples; the winding Sŏktong valley was celebrated for its cliffs and scenery.
simp_chinese: 载宁位于黄海道宽广的低地，河流排泄肥沃平原上的水，向西流入大海。载宁平原延及邻近数郡，自古以稻米闻名，所产米曾进献王室。低地南面的长寿山耸立在河谷和寺院之上，蜿蜒的石洞谷则以峭壁胜景著称。

english:
Jaffa occupies a rocky promontory on the Mediterranean coast, its harbour serving the inland cities of Palestine and pilgrims bound for Jerusalem. The port's reefs made anchorage difficult, but its position drew merchants and travellers from Egypt and across the sea. Long contested by coastal rulers, the town was reduced in the later Middle Ages and gradually recovered under Ottoman rule.

By the seventeenth century Christian communities had established lodgings for pilgrims, and merchants from Europe and the eastern Mediterranean visited the port. Cotton yarn and alkali ashes were among the goods shipped abroad. In the eighteenth century Jaffa became involved in struggles between regional rulers: it was besieged and captured in 1773 and again in 1775, when Muhammad Abu al-Dhahab's forces killed many inhabitants. The orchards around the town nevertheless helped sustain its recovery, and by the middle of the century travellers had noted the oranges grown there.

In March 1799 Napoleon besieged Jaffa during his campaign from Egypt. French troops stormed the town, killed prisoners after its fall and remained only briefly before withdrawing. Conflict continued until the Ottoman governor Muhammad Agha Abu Nabbut restored order in the early nineteenth century. He strengthened the defences and sponsored public buildings, including a mosque, market and fountains, as the port resumed its role in trade and pilgrimage.
simp_chinese:
雅法坐落在地中海岸的岩石岬角，港口服务于巴勒斯坦内陆城市和前往耶路撒冷的朝圣者。礁石使停泊颇为困难，但地理位置仍吸引埃及及海外各地的商人与旅人。海岸统治者长期争夺此地；城镇在中世纪后期衰落，奥斯曼时期逐渐恢复。

到十七世纪，基督徒社群已为朝圣者设立旅舍，欧洲和东地中海商人也来到港口。出口货物包括棉纱和碱灰。十八世纪，雅法卷入地区统治者之间的争斗：一七七三年和一七七五年先后被围攻占领，后一回穆罕默德·阿布扎哈卜的军队杀害了许多居民。尽管如此，城外果园仍为城镇恢复提供了基础；十八世纪中叶，旅行者已注意到当地种植的柑橘。

一七九九年三月，拿破仑从埃及进军时围攻雅法。法军攻入城镇，城破后杀害战俘，短暂占领后撤走。此后争斗仍在继续，直到十九世纪初奥斯曼总督穆罕默德·阿加·阿布纳布特恢复秩序。他加固城防，资助修建清真寺、市场和公共水泉，港口也重新承担贸易与朝圣交通的作用。

english:
Jaffna lies on a peninsula in northern Sri Lanka, facing the sea routes to southern India. It was the port of a Tamil kingdom whose royal centre stood at nearby Nallur. Merchants exchanged the products of the peninsula and the interior across the strait, including elephants sought in overseas markets. Hindu temples and the Tamil language linked the kingdom to the cultural world of southern India.

The Aryacakravarti rulers maintained a kingdom at Jaffna through much of the later medieval period, although Kotte briefly conquered it in the fifteenth century. In 1619 a Portuguese expedition defeated Cankili II and ended the independent kingdom. Resistance continued, including support from forces associated with Thanjavur. The Portuguese shifted their headquarters from Nallur to the coastal settlement of Jaffna, where a fort could be supplied by sea. They built churches and defensive works across the peninsula. In 1658 the Dutch captured Jaffna from the Portuguese and made the fort a centre of their own administration. The harbour and its fort remained a strategic link between Sri Lanka and the mainland across the strait.
simp_chinese:
贾夫纳位于斯里兰卡北部半岛，面向通往南印度的海路。它是一个泰米尔王国的港口，王室中心位于附近的纳卢尔。商人跨海峡交换半岛与内陆的物产，其中包括海外市场所需的大象。印度教寺庙与泰米尔语使王国同南印度文化世界相连。

阿里亚查克拉瓦蒂统治者在中世纪后期大部分时间维持贾夫纳王国，尽管科特曾在十五世纪短暂征服此地。1619年葡萄牙远征军击败桑吉利二世，结束独立王国。抵抗仍在继续，包括来自坦贾武尔相关军队的支持。葡萄牙人将驻地从纳卢尔迁至沿海贾夫纳聚落，那里堡垒可由海上补给；他们还在半岛兴建教堂与防御工事。1658年荷兰人从葡萄牙手中夺取贾夫纳，并以堡垒为行政中心。港口与要塞始终是斯里兰卡和海峡对岸大陆之间的重要联系。

english:
Jagadevipalayam lay beneath a double-peaked hill in the Baramahal country. Its western summit was called Devalapadi and its eastern summit Jagadevidurgam, where the principal fort dominated the settlement below. The place was associated with the family of Jagadeva Raya, military chiefs connected with the later Vijayanagara court, and was remembered as a capital of the twelve mahals from which the region took its name.

The family's fortunes linked this hill fort to campaigns farther north. In 1589 Jagadeva Raya II defended Penukonda against a Golconda army and received Chennapatna as a reward; the grant led him to transfer his capital there from Jagadevi. Later generations continued to hold the Baramahal, but Mysore's expansion under Chamaraja weakened their position. Jagadevipalayam's history thus followed a military family's shifting centres of power: the fort guarded its immediate settlement while service, grants and conquest connected it to other courts across the southern plateau.
simp_chinese:
贾加德维帕拉扬位于巴拉马哈尔地区的一座双峰山下。西峰称德瓦拉帕迪，东峰称贾加德维杜尔加姆，主要堡垒俯瞰山下聚落。这里与贾加德瓦·拉亚家族相联系；他们是依附毗奢耶那伽罗晚期宫廷的军事首领。地方传统将此地视为“十二马哈尔”的首府，巴拉马哈尔的地区名称也由此而来。

家族兴衰将山堡与更北方的战事相连。1589年，贾加德瓦·拉亚二世抵御戈尔康达军队进攻佩努孔达，获授金纳帕特纳，随后将首府从贾加德维迁往那里。后世仍一度保有巴拉马哈尔，但迈索尔在查马拉贾治下的扩张削弱了他们的地位。这个聚落的历史，因而随军事家族权力中心的转移而展开：堡垒控制邻近聚落，服役、授地与征服则将它接入南部高原的其他王廷。

english: Jagaraga was a Javanese principality in the country north of Magetan, near Madiun. It belonged to the shifting political landscape of eastern Java in the late sixteenth century, when Mataram expanded from its base in central Java. After the conquest of Madiun in 1590–91, Mataram extended its authority towards neighbouring territories, including Jagaraga. The region lies among the valleys and lowlands east of the volcanic mountains of central Java.
simp_chinese: 贾加拉加曾是爪哇的一个地方政权，位于马格丹以北、茉莉芬附近。十六世纪末，马打蓝从中爪哇的根据地向外扩张，东爪哇的政治格局随之变化。1590 至 1591 年征服茉莉芬后，马打蓝又将权力伸向邻近地区，包括贾加拉加。这里处在中爪哇火山山地以东的河谷和低地之间。

english: Near this part of the western Himalayan hills lies the Sinja Valley, once the centre of the Khasa Malla kingdom. Ruins in the valley include palaces and stone monuments associated with its rulers. Sinja was also a centre of the early Nepali language, whose old inscriptions preserve evidence of its development. Other remains of the Khasa kingdom are found farther south at Dullu and Bhurti.
simp_chinese: 西喜马拉雅山区的这一带靠近辛贾谷地，那里曾是卡萨马拉王国的中心。谷地保存着与统治者有关的宫殿遗址和石造纪念物。辛贾也是早期尼泊尔语的中心，古老铭文留下了这种语言发展的证据。卡萨王国的其他遗迹则见于更南方的杜卢和布尔蒂。

english:
Jagdalpur became the capital of Bastar under Dalpat Deo after a Maratha invasion around 1750. The former capital, also called Bastar, stood north of the Indravati; the new royal centre lay south of the river. This move formed part of a troubled reign. After the death of Rajpal Deo in 1721, rival claimants had displaced Dalpat, who sought refuge in Jeypore before recovering the throne in 1731.

The court at Jagdalpur governed a kingdom whose chiefs and village communities retained considerable local importance. Danteshwari, worshipped at Dantewada, remained the ruling family's tutelary goddess. Under Dalpat's successor Daryao Deo, the Halba rising brought further conflict within the state. Maratha influence did not amount to continuous direct administration throughout the forest country. The royal settlement stood within a network of local authorities and sacred centres extending well beyond the palace.
simp_chinese:
杰格德尔布尔在达尔帕特·德奥统治时期成为巴斯塔尔首都，迁都发生在约1750年马拉塔军队入侵之后。旧都巴斯塔尔位于因陀罗瓦蒂河以北，新的王廷中心则在河南。这次迁移属于一段动荡统治：拉杰帕尔·德奥于1721年去世后，竞争者曾将达尔帕特排挤出局，他逃往杰伊普尔，直到1731年才夺回王位。

杰格德尔布尔王廷统辖的王国中，地方首领与村落社群仍具有重要地位。供奉在丹泰瓦达的丹泰什瓦里女神，是统治家族的保护神。达尔帕特的继承者达里亚奥·德奥在位时，哈尔巴人的起事又使国内发生冲突。马拉塔的影响并未转化为对全部森林地区的持续直接行政。王室聚落依靠的地方权威与圣地网络，远远超出宫殿本身。

english: Jagga Kalemba lies inland from the Atlantic near the Bentiaba River. The Bentiaba reaches the sea on the dry coast of southwestern Angola, where the cold Benguela Current flows north. In 1485–86, the Portuguese navigator Diogo Cão sailed this coast and raised a stone pillar at Cabo Negro farther south.
simp_chinese: 贾加卡伦巴位于大西洋内陆，靠近本蒂亚巴河。本蒂亚巴河在安哥拉西南部干燥的海岸流入大海，本格拉寒流沿岸向北流淌。1485至1486年，葡萄牙航海家迪奥戈·康驶过这一海岸，在更南面的黑角竖立石柱。

english:
Jaggas lies in the Kwango country on the eastern margin of the Kingdom of Kongo, where open woodland and river valleys meet the grasslands beyond. Farming villages grew cassava and millet, kept goats and fowl, and traded salt and iron with neighbours. Paths linked the riverside settlements to the markets of the Kongo heartland to the west.

The name Jaga entered European writing through the upheavals of the late sixteenth century. In 1568, armed newcomers drove King Álvaro I from his capital, and the Italian writer Filippo Pigafetta, drawing on the Portuguese traveller Duarte Lopes, later published an account in 1591 of the Portuguese troops who helped restore the king. The Jaga raids struck the eastern provinces hard, and for generations afterwards Kongo's rulers faced pressure from raiders and rebels on their borders.
simp_chinese:
贾加斯位于宽果地区，处在刚果王国东部边缘，开阔的林地和河谷向外延伸为草原。农业村落种植木薯和小米，饲养山羊与家禽，并与邻近村落交换盐和铁器。小径把沿河聚落与西面刚果腹地的市场相连。

“贾加”之名通过十六世纪后期的动荡进入欧洲人的记述。1568年，武装的外来者把阿尔瓦罗一世赶出首都。意大利作家菲利波·皮加费塔依据葡萄牙旅行者杜阿尔特·洛佩斯的材料，于1591年出版了记述，提到葡萄牙军队协助国王复位。贾加人的袭击重创东部各省，此后数代刚果统治者都要应对边境上的袭掠与叛乱。

english: Jagin-e Zir lies in the dry Makran country of southern Balochistan, where valleys descend from the hills toward the Gulf of Oman. Cultivation depended on the water of those valleys and of desert springs, and coastal routes linked the settlement with the Indian Ocean. Its people were Baloch, and their livelihood combined small fields with orchards and herding.
simp_chinese: 下贾金位于俾路支斯坦南部干旱的莫克兰地带，河谷从山地向阿曼湾延伸。耕作依靠这些河谷与荒漠泉水，沿海路线把聚落同印度洋相连。居民为俾路支人，生计兼有小块农田、果园与放牧。

english: Jagodina stands on the Belica River in central Serbia. Its name appears in a letter to Princess Milica in 1399, and a Serbian assembly met here in 1411. After the Ottoman conquest the town grew as a stopping place on the road to Constantinople, with inns, mosques and a bath serving its inhabitants and travellers. In 1555 Dervish Bey Jahjapašić endowed a large mosque, and a German craftsman made a clock tower for the town. By the seventeenth century Jagodina also had a covered market. The Habsburgs made it a district centre after their war with the Ottomans in 1716–18, but Ottoman rule returned after the next war ended in 1739.
simp_chinese: 雅戈丁纳坐落在塞尔维亚中部的贝利察河畔。它的名字见于1399年写给米利察公主的信件，1411年塞尔维亚的一次会议也在这里召开。奥斯曼征服后，城镇发展为通往君士坦丁堡道路上的驿站，旅店、清真寺和浴场服务居民与过客。1555年，德尔维什贝伊·雅赫亚帕希奇捐建一座大清真寺，一位德国工匠还为城镇建造了钟楼。到十七世纪，雅戈丁纳也有了一座有顶市场。1716至1718年哈布斯堡与奥斯曼战争后，哈布斯堡将此地设为地区中心；但下一次战争于1739年结束后，奥斯曼统治又恢复了。

english:
Jaguarão developed beside its namesake river in the border country disputed by Portugal and Spain. A Spanish military presence preceded the Portuguese guard from which the later town grew. In the early nineteenth century, after campaigning in the area, Portuguese forces left a smaller garrison beside the river. Houses and other settlement activity gathered around this military nucleus.

In 1812 the settlement became the parish of Divino Espírito Santo do Cerrito, and in 1832 it was raised to the rank of vila. Political rivalry did not end movement across the river. Families, informal commerce and cattle properties on both sides maintained connections that crossed the emerging frontier. The settlement faced the territory that became Uruguay as well as the Brazilian hinterland. Military occupation and pastoral exchange thus shaped its beginnings together, before the region entered the upheaval of the Farroupilha revolt in 1835.
simp_chinese:
雅瓜朗沿同名河发展，地处葡萄牙与西班牙争夺的边地。葡萄牙驻防以前，这一带已有西班牙军队活动。十九世纪初，葡军在当地作战后留下较小的守备队，后来聚落便围绕河边这一军事核心形成。

1812年，居民点升为名叫“塞里托圣灵”的教区，1832年又升为镇。政治对立没有终止跨河往来，家庭联系、非正式贸易与分布河流两侧的牧牛地产，继续维持正在形成的边界两边的社会纽带。聚落既面向巴西内陆，也朝向后来成为乌拉圭的地域。驻防与牧业交换共同塑造其早期历史，直到1835年地区进入法鲁皮利亚起义带来的动荡。

english: Jaguarari belongs to the dry interior of northern Bahia, near the old mining country of Jacobina. Indigenous people lived in these hills before Portuguese cattlemen and prospectors advanced inland. In the seventeenth century farms and cattle pens spread through the district, while seekers of gold and silver entered the Jacobina lands. The rock walls around Jaguarari preserve much older paintings and engravings, including geometric and animal forms.
simp_chinese: 雅瓜拉里位于巴伊亚北部干燥的内陆，靠近雅各比纳古老的采矿地区。在葡萄牙牧牛人和探矿者深入内陆之前，原住民已经生活在这些山地。十七世纪，农庄和牛栏向这一带扩展，寻找金银的人也进入雅各比纳地区。雅瓜拉里周围的岩壁保存着古老得多的绘画与刻画，其中有几何形和动物形图案。

english: Jahreh lies in the warm valleys of southern Fars, north of Qir and Karzin. Medieval geographers described these towns near the right bank of the Sakkan River, south of the Simkan district. Palm groves grew in this warmer country, where settlements drew water from the river and its tributaries. Karzin was an old centre of the district, while Qir stood farther west.
simp_chinese: 贾赫雷位于法尔斯南部温暖的河谷中，吉尔与卡尔津在其南方。中世纪地理学家记载，这些城镇位于西姆坎地区以南、萨坎河右岸附近。温暖地带生长着枣林，聚落从河流及其支流取水。卡尔津是当地古老的中心，吉尔则位于更西面。

english:
Jahrom lay in central Fars on the route linking the Persian Gulf with Shiraz and Isfahan. Medieval geographical accounts describe a town supplied by streams and underground water channels, with dependent settlements around it. Under the Safavids, growing European trade through the Gulf increased the importance of this inland connection. Caravanserais stood on the stages between Lar and Jahrom and between Jahrom and Shiraz, although travellers found the road difficult.

In the reign of Shah Abbas I, Jahrom formed part of the crown lands. Its economy also appears through surviving copper coins bearing the city's mint name.
